words.englishDefinition: Make something new, such as a product or a mental or artistic creation
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい何かを作る、例えば製品または精神的であるか芸術的な創造。
words.example: We need to develop a new kind of energy.

words.englishDefinition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを起こすことを行動の特定の動きまたは、動かないことより可能にする。
words.example: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.

words.englishDefinition: Persist for a specified period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の期間やり通す。
words.example: I wonder how long this cold weather will last.

words.englishDefinition: Desire strongly or persistently
words.japaneseExplanation: 強くまたは継続的に渇望する。
words.example: I moved back to Boston not to long ago.

words.englishDefinition: Mount or put up
words.japaneseExplanation: 展開する、または提供する。
words.example: I hope to provide you with good food at a low price.

words.englishDefinition: Move out of or depart from
words.japaneseExplanation: 出て行く、または立ち去る。
words.example: I turned out the light and left the room.

words.englishDefinition: Arrange for and reserve (something for someone else) in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 前もって手配し、確保する（他の誰かのための何か）。
words.example: Please book me a room in a first-class hotel.

words.englishDefinition: Give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 引き起こす。常に意図的というわけではなく、生起させるまたは生じさせる。
words.example: I don't want to cause an accident.

words.englishDefinition: Have ownership or possession of
words.japaneseExplanation: 所有権または、の所持。
words.example: I only own half as many books as he does.

words.englishDefinition: Be priced at
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段がつく。
words.example: I do not know how much it can cost now.

words.englishDefinition: To make better
words.japaneseExplanation: よりよくする。
words.example: I just want to improve as much as I can.

words.englishDefinition: Fill or meet a want or need
words.japaneseExplanation: 欲望または必要性を満たす、あるいはこれらに合致する。
words.example: I want to meet people from all over the world.

words.englishDefinition: Cut down on; make a reduction in
words.japaneseExplanation: カットして減らす。減少させる。
words.example: I think that we should reduce the price.

words.englishDefinition: Any malignant growth or tumor caused by abnormal and uncontrolled cell division; it may spread to other parts of the body through the lymphatic system or the blood stream
words.japaneseExplanation: 異常な、またはコントロール不良の細胞分裂によって引き起こされる悪性の腫瘍や腫れ。リンパ系や血流を通して身体の他の部位に広がる。
words.example: I know about your cancer.

words.englishDefinition: The amount that can be contained
words.japaneseExplanation: 入れることが可能な量。
words.example: I have the capacity to think for myself.

words.englishDefinition: The general progression of your working or professional life
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的人生の大まかな歩み。
words.example: I want to have a career before I get married.

words.englishDefinition: A geological formation consisting of an underground enclosure with access from the surface of the ground or from the sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 地面の表面、または海からのアクセスのある地下の囲い地から成る地層。
words.example: Do you think it's safe to go into this cave?

words.englishDefinition: A thorough physical examination; includes a variety of tests depending on the age and sex and health of the person
words.japaneseExplanation: 徹底的な身体検査。各人の年齢、性、健康状態に応じた様々なテストを含む。
words.example: I had a checkup the week before last.

words.englishDefinition: A specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
words.japaneseExplanation: 義務として、あるいは、特定の料金のために行うことを要求される特定の仕事。
words.example: You can go play with your friends when your chores are done.

words.englishDefinition: A condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの出来事か活動に伴うか、または影響を及ぼす状態。
words.example: What would you do in this circumstance?

words.englishDefinition: The act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じタイプのクラスかカテゴリに事態を分配する行為。
words.example: I don't fit that classification.

words.englishDefinition: An event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental
words.japaneseExplanation: 本当に偶然だったが、準備されていたかもしれない出来事。
words.example: I wonder if it really was a coincidence.

words.englishDefinition: A special group delegated to consider some matter
words.japaneseExplanation: ある問題について検討することを委ねられた特別のグループ。
words.example: We want the committee to work out this problem.

words.englishDefinition: A friend who is frequently in the company of another
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば別の仲間の中にいる友人。
words.example: You asked me to be your companion.

words.englishDefinition: A body serving in an administrative capacity
words.japaneseExplanation: 運営機関として働く団体。
words.example: What will the city council do about it?

words.englishDefinition: The practice or manner of preparing food or the food so prepared
words.japaneseExplanation: 料理を準備するような食料の習慣、方法、あるいは準備。
words.example: Do you enjoy the cuisine of your country?

words.englishDefinition: Having unexpected good fortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 思いがけない幸運があるさま。
words.example: You are fortunate for having such good friends.

words.englishDefinition: Vulnerably delicate
words.japaneseExplanation: 傷つきやすく繊細な。
words.example: Could you put these fragile things in a safe place?

words.englishDefinition: Not petty in character and mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 性質と心が小さくない。
words.example: How generous you are to give me so much money.

words.englishDefinition: Prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律で、あるいは公式であるか認められた規則によって禁止される。
words.example: I didn't know that what we were doing was illegal.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or associated with an empire
words.japaneseExplanation: 帝国に関して、または、それに関連した。
words.example: I have two passes to the Imperial Theater.

words.englishDefinition: Not formal
words.japaneseExplanation: 正式でない。
words.example: You can make an informal application at any time.

words.englishDefinition: Consisting of or related to language
words.japaneseExplanation: 言語から成る、または、関連づけられる。
words.example: I go out of my way to seek linguistic diversity.

words.englishDefinition: Slightly wet
words.japaneseExplanation: わずかに湿った。
words.example: Her eyes were moist with tears.

words.englishDefinition: related to the energy released by changes in atoms
words.japaneseExplanation: 原子核や、原子核の変化から生じるエネルギーに関すること。
words.example: We discussed the advantages and disadvantages of nuclear power.

words.englishDefinition: Not divisible by two
words.japaneseExplanation: 2で割り切れない。
words.example: You two are an odd pair.

words.englishDefinition: Relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis
words.japaneseExplanation: 炭素基を持つ化学的化合物の類の属すまたは関係する。
words.example: My friend only eats organic food.

words.englishDefinition: Continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
words.japaneseExplanation: 状態、条件、または場所を大きく変えることなく続く、または持ちこたえる。
words.example: I think that it's a permanent change.

words.englishDefinition: Of high worth or cost
words.japaneseExplanation: 高い価値か費用の。
words.example: My father used to say that time is precious.

words.englishDefinition: Transport commercially
words.japaneseExplanation: 営利目的で輸送する。
words.example: You will ship the book before Monday.

words.englishDefinition: Reach or come to rest
words.japaneseExplanation: 静止するようになる。
words.example: I do know when your plane will land, but not when it takes off.

words.englishDefinition: Present for acceptance or rejection
words.japaneseExplanation: 承諾または拒絶を示す。
words.example: I was going to offer to buy you a drink.

words.japanese: 経営する・立候補する
words.englishDefinition: Direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 指示する、または制御する。プロジェクト、ビジネス、等。
words.example: I want you to run to the store for me.

words.englishDefinition: Make bigger or more
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きいかより多くする。
words.example: I would like to increase the price.

words.englishDefinition: Create or manufacture a man-made product
words.japaneseExplanation: 人工の製品を作成または製造する。
words.example: We don't produce anything any more.

words.englishDefinition: Include or contain; have as a component
words.japaneseExplanation: 包含するか、含む。構成要素として持つ。
words.example: I couldn't contain myself any longer.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move; cause to be in a certain position or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 移動させる。ある位置または状態にさせる。
words.example: Please let me tell you a little bit about this position.

words.englishDefinition: Remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か具体的なものを削除する、持ち上げる、押すこと、あるいは切り離すことなどにより、あるいは何か抽象的なものを削除する。
words.example: I had to remove some of the things I had.

words.englishDefinition: Interact in a certain way
words.japaneseExplanation: ある方法で交わる。
words.example: What did I do for you to treat me like this?

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be attached
words.japaneseExplanation: 取り付けられる。
words.example: I don't attach as much value to school as the other boys.

words.englishDefinition: Stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 接触がないままでいる。離れた状態を維持する。
words.example: We took a back road to avoid the heavy traffic.

words.englishDefinition: Give shape or form to
words.japaneseExplanation: 形体または型を何かに与える。
words.example: You don't have to form an opinion on everything.

words.englishDefinition: The trace of a point whose direction of motion changes
words.japaneseExplanation: 運動方向が変化する点の形跡。
words.example: I don't know how to throw a curve ball.

words.englishDefinition: The state of owing something (especially money)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（特に金銭）を借りている状態。
words.example: I went to pay off my debt at the bank.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of having an inferior or less favorable position
words.japaneseExplanation: 下位の、またはより好ましくない位置にあるという特質。
words.example: We have a disadvantage here.

words.englishDefinition: Unfair treatment of a person or group on the basis of prejudice
words.japaneseExplanation: 偏見に基づく個人またはグループの不当な扱い。
words.example: They are poor because of the discrimination against them.

words.englishDefinition: The boundary of a surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面の境界。
words.example: We walked as far as the edge of the forest.

words.englishDefinition: The form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published
words.japaneseExplanation: テキスト（特に印刷された本）が出版される形。
words.example: The book is now in its 6th edition.

words.englishDefinition: A sudden unforeseen crisis (usually involving danger) that requires immediate action
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然の思いがけない危機（通例危険を伴う）で緊急な行動をとる必要があること。
words.example: What number should I call in case of an emergency?

words.englishDefinition: An analytic or interpretive literary composition
words.japaneseExplanation: 分析的、または説明的な文芸創作。
words.example: I learned that while doing an essay on them at school.

words.englishDefinition: Money spent to perform work and usually reimbursed by an employer
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事上に使用され、通常雇用者によって返済される金。
words.example: I guess you had a great time at his expense.

words.englishDefinition: The state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く称えられ、賞賛されている状態もしくは特質。
words.example: Despite all his fame, he is not happy.

words.englishDefinition: A severe shortage of food (as through crop failure) resulting in violent hunger and starvation and death
words.japaneseExplanation: 激しい飢えと飢餓と死をもたらす（収穫不作を通した）厳しい食糧難。
words.example: Can you share food with others in the face of famine?

words.englishDefinition: The sum charged for riding in a public conveyance
words.japaneseExplanation: 公共の乗物の利用に対する請求額。
words.example: How much is the fare on the bus?

words.englishDefinition: The act of departing politely
words.japaneseExplanation: 礼儀正しく出発する行為。
words.example: We are going to hold a farewell party for him.

words.englishDefinition: Carrying developing offspring within the body or being about to produce new life
words.japaneseExplanation: 体に発達中の子供を持つ、または、新しい生命を作り出す。
words.example: My family need to know that you got me pregnant.

words.englishDefinition: First in rank or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: ランク付けや階級においての1番。
words.example: You are no longer in the prime of life.

words.englishDefinition: Acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed
words.japaneseExplanation: その時に正確に作用する、到着する、実行される、あるいは指定する。
words.example: I expect you to be punctual.

words.englishDefinition: Not processed or subjected to analysis
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理されていない、または分析されていない。
words.example: I thought that you said you couldn't eat raw fish.

words.englishDefinition: Not excessive or extreme
words.japaneseExplanation: 過剰でないか極端ではない。
words.example: I know a good store with reasonable prices.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of a region
words.japaneseExplanation: 領域の特性。
words.example: I eventually want to become regional manager.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
words.japaneseExplanation: 神性な事柄、宗教または教会に関する。
words.example: Do you consider yourself a religious person?

words.englishDefinition: Socially incorrect in behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会的に誤った行動。
words.example: You promised not to be rude to me any more.

words.englishDefinition: Deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
words.japaneseExplanation: 量や数が、需要に比べて不十分である。
words.example: Water is scarce in this area.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring at or dependent on a particular season
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の季節に発生すること、あるいは依存するさま。
words.example: I know a very rich girl who only eats seasonal vegetables.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の人を除外して自分と自分の利益を主にまたはそれしか関心がない。
words.example: You need to learn how to start being selfish.

words.englishDefinition: Older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 年齢が上であるさま。地位がより高いさま。
words.example: We look up to him as a good senior.

words.englishDefinition: Responsive to physical stimuli
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的な刺激に敏感な。
words.example: My eyes are very sensitive to the light.

words.englishDefinition: Take somebody somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かをどこかに連れて行く。
words.example: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.

words.englishDefinition: Keep from happening or arising; make impossible
words.japaneseExplanation: 起きてしまうことまたは発生することを防ぐ。不可能にする。
words.example: We have to prevent such an accident from happening again.

words.japanese: 覆う・(話題などを)扱う
words.englishDefinition: Provide with a covering or cause to be covered
words.japaneseExplanation: カバーを供給するか、カバーされるようにする。
words.example: You have to cover your mouth when you're sick.

words.englishDefinition: Detect with the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚で検出する。
words.example: I wonder if she will recognize me after all those years.

words.englishDefinition: Push for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを要求する。
words.example: I would recommend this book even more than the first.

words.englishDefinition: Spread across or over
words.japaneseExplanation: 横切って、あるいはその上に広がる。
words.example: We need to spread the word.

words.englishDefinition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
words.example: I was just going to suggest that you do that.

words.englishDefinition: Give moral or psychological support, aid, or courage to
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神的あるいは心理的な支援、援助、または勇気を与える。
words.example: I have a wife and three children to support.

words.englishDefinition: Connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つ、それ以上のものをつなげる、固める一緒にする。
words.example: Do you feel like you cannot connect with other people?

words.englishDefinition: Have as a part, be made up out of
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分としてある、の中から作られた。
words.example: For some reason, they didn't include my name on the list.

words.japanese: のままである・残っている
words.englishDefinition: Stay the same; remain in a certain state
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じでいる。ある状態に保つ。
words.example: You don't really want to remain here, do you?

words.englishDefinition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
words.example: What would it cost to repair this chair?

words.englishDefinition: Spend thoughtlessly; throw away
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽率に費やす。浪費する。
words.example: You must be careful not to waste time.

words.englishDefinition: An imperfection in an object or machine
words.japaneseExplanation: 物または機械の欠陥。
words.example: You talk as if it's my fault.

words.englishDefinition: An act of gracious kindness
words.japaneseExplanation: 丁寧で親切な行為。
words.example: I gave him a present in return for his favor.

words.englishDefinition: A boy or man
words.japaneseExplanation: 少年または男。
words.example: I don't believe I've ever seen that fellow.

words.englishDefinition: A slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn
words.japaneseExplanation: 紡がれて紡績糸になることのできる細く、とても長くされた物質。
words.example: I love my country with every fiber of my being.

words.englishDefinition: A deliberately false or improbable account
words.japaneseExplanation: 故意に誤ったまたは本当とは思えない説明。
words.example: How can you tell fact from fiction?

words.englishDefinition: One of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration
words.japaneseExplanation: 記数の体系を集合的に形作る要素の1つ。
words.example: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

words.englishDefinition: The soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat
words.japaneseExplanation: 脊椎動物の身体の柔らかい組織：主として筋肉組織と脂肪。
words.example: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.

words.englishDefinition: Fine powdery foodstuff obtained by grinding and sifting the meal of a cereal grain
words.japaneseExplanation: シリアル粒の食物をつぶすまたはふるうことで得られる細かい粉状の食料品。
words.example: We went to the market, and I bought some flour.

words.englishDefinition: An international boundary or the area (often fortified) immediately inside the boundary
words.japaneseExplanation: 国境線またはその境のすぐ内側の地帯（しばしば防壁のある）。
words.example: We crossed the frontier yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: A ceremony at which a dead person is buried or cremated
words.japaneseExplanation: 死者が埋められたり火葬にされる儀式。
words.example: I am going to attend a funeral tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 宇宙のすべての塊の間の引力。特に、地球の表面付近の物体に対する地球の質量の引力。
words.example: I am well aware of the gravity of the situation.

words.englishDefinition: The type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体またはグループが通常生活または発生する環境の種類。
words.example: I live in a space habitat.

words.englishDefinition: A state of misfortune or affliction
words.japaneseExplanation: 不幸なもしくは苦痛な状態。
words.example: You will have to go through hardship.

words.englishDefinition: Resistant to change of position or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 位置または状態の変化に抵抗する。
words.example: I put the horse back in the stable yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 特にふるまいにおける変更または変化への対象ではない。
words.example: You need to find yourself a steady job.

words.englishDefinition: Difficult to detect or grasp by the mind or analyze
words.japaneseExplanation: 心または分析により検出する、あるいは把握することが難しい。
words.example: I will pay him back later in a subtle way.

words.englishDefinition: Of high or superior quality or performance
words.japaneseExplanation: 高い、あるいは優れた品質か性能の。
words.example: You think you're superior to me in every way.

words.englishDefinition: Openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかに不信で、委託をしたがらない。
words.example: I do believe that you are suspicious of me.

words.englishDefinition: Full of trivial conversation
words.japaneseExplanation: 些細な会話でいっぱいである。
words.example: I noticed straight away that he wasn't really very talkative.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
words.japaneseExplanation: 毒素または毒物の、毒素または毒物に関する、あるいは、毒素または毒物に引き起こされる。
words.example: How do you get over a toxic job?

words.englishDefinition: Difficult to deal with
words.japaneseExplanation: 対処するのが難しい。
words.example: We have to somehow come through this troublesome situation.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of trust or belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 信用または信念に値する。
words.example: What is seen in movies and on TV is not trustworthy.

words.englishDefinition: empty and available for someone to use
words.japaneseExplanation: 人が使っておらず、空いていること。
words.example: Is there a vacant seat near the window?

words.englishDefinition: Not clearly understood or expressed
words.japaneseExplanation: 明確に理解されないか、または表現されない。
words.example: Do you have a vague idea about what's in the box?

words.englishDefinition: Sufficient for the purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的のために十分な。
words.example: I don't consider that adequate.

words.englishDefinition: Having or displaying warmth or affection
words.japaneseExplanation: 暖かさまたは愛情を持つか、表すさま。
words.example: It's not possible for us to be very affectionate.

words.englishDefinition: Ask (for something)
words.japaneseExplanation: （何かを）求める。
words.example: What kind of job do you want to apply for?

words.englishDefinition: Operate or control a vehicle
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗り物を操作するかコントロールする。
words.example: You yourself need to learn how to drive a car.

words.englishDefinition: Inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to
words.japaneseExplanation: 自信がわいてくる。望みや勇気を与える。
words.example: You have to encourage him to become a teacher!

words.englishDefinition: Express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent
words.japaneseExplanation: 異論、抗議または批評を示す、または異議を唱える。
words.example: Do you think anyone would object if we did that?

words.englishDefinition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
words.example: I have to prepare to go to school.

words.englishDefinition: To keep up and reserve for personal or special use
words.japaneseExplanation: 私的または特別の使用のために続けるまたは取っておく。
words.example: We had to smoke our meat to preserve it.

words.englishDefinition: Make a promise or commitment
words.japaneseExplanation: 約束する、または、誓約する。
words.example: Please promise me that you'll never lie to me again.

words.englishDefinition: Substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
words.japaneseExplanation: の代わりに人またはものを代用する（壊れている、能率が悪い、紛失した、これ以上動かないあるいは期待されていることを産出できない別のもの）。
words.example: We won't be able to replace it.

words.englishDefinition: Give something useful or necessary to
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを役に立つまたは必要であるものにする。
words.example: The store can supply us with anything we need.

words.englishDefinition: Notify of danger, potential harm, or risk
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険、潜在的害または危険を通知する。
words.example: I came here to warn you about what might happen.

words.englishDefinition: Direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
words.japaneseExplanation: 心理学的力または物理的属性という手段でそのものまたはその人自身に直接向けられた。
words.example: How to attract and keep new customers for a small business?

words.englishDefinition: Examine and note the similarities or differences of
words.japaneseExplanation: 類似点または相違点を検討し留意する。
words.example: I don't think you should compare yourself to others.

words.englishDefinition: Provide a cure for, make healthy again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び健康にするよう、治療する。
words.example: You think that you can cure yourself, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: The state of being honored
words.japaneseExplanation: 名誉を与えられていること。
words.example: I can't tell you what an honor this is.

words.englishDefinition: Inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば特定の刺激に対して反応するときの持って生まれた行動パターン。
words.example: My instinct said I could trust you.

words.englishDefinition: Promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
words.japaneseExplanation: 損失の場合に償還する契約。危険を心配して保険会社に前納した人々または会社に支払われる。
words.example: My son-in-law works at an insurance company.

words.englishDefinition: An anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図している、または計画した行動を導く、予期された結果。
words.example: I didn't mean to make you angry, the intention was good.

words.englishDefinition: A mutual or reciprocal action; interacting
words.japaneseExplanation: 相互の、あるいは双方向の行為。交流すること。
words.example: I expect respect in every interaction I have.

words.englishDefinition: The act of investing; laying out money or capital in an enterprise with the expectation of profit
words.japaneseExplanation: 投資する行為。利益を期待して、事業に金銭や資本を投資すること。
words.example: How much of a return did you get on your investment?

words.englishDefinition: An important question that is in dispute and must be settled
words.japaneseExplanation: 論争の重要な論点で、解決しなければならないこと。
words.example: Could you share your honest opinion on this issue?

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being just or fair
words.japaneseExplanation: 公正または公平である性質。
words.example: My grandfather was a justice of the peace.

words.japanese: 目印・画期的な出来事
words.englishDefinition: The position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape
words.japaneseExplanation: ある特殊な土地で際立って、有名な物の位置。
words.example: Do you see a landmark?

words.englishDefinition: An expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
words.japaneseExplanation: 一目で見られる景色の広がり。
words.example: I've never seen a landscape this big.

words.englishDefinition: A narrow way or road
words.japaneseExplanation: 細い道または道路。
words.example: I had a lane all to myself at the swimming pool today.

words.englishDefinition: A professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
words.japaneseExplanation: 弁護士の権限を与えられた専門家。訴訟を行ったり法律上の助言を与えたりする。
words.example: My father-in-law is a lawyer.

words.englishDefinition: The ability to lead
words.japaneseExplanation: 指導力。
words.example: We have a leadership problem.

words.englishDefinition: Exceptionally bad or displeasing
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に悪いか、または不快である。
words.example: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違いや欠点を見つけ、それらに注視する傾向に特徴的な。
words.example: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

words.englishDefinition: Not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality
words.japaneseExplanation: 事実、現実または現実性に従ってではなく。
words.example: What he said turned out to be false.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by extreme anger
words.japaneseExplanation: 極端な怒りで、マークされる。
words.example: My dad is often furious because of his car.

words.englishDefinition: Parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
words.japaneseExplanation: 平行線または基線に対して平行または同じ面に属して。
words.example: I used a spirit level to make sure the shelf was perfectly horizontal.

words.englishDefinition: Of or characteristic of low rank or importance
words.japaneseExplanation: 下位または重要でないもの、あるいは、下位または重要でないもに特徴的な。
words.example: You think that your language is inferior.

words.englishDefinition: Free from evil or guilt
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪または罪とは無縁の。
words.example: How can you tell who's innocent and who's guilty?

words.englishDefinition: Clean or organized
words.japaneseExplanation: 健全である、または組織立っているさま。
words.example: I want to keep my room as neat as possible.

words.japanese: どちらの〜も・・・ない
words.englishDefinition: not one and not the other of two
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つのどちらも当てはまらないことを表す。
words.example: Neither of these shirts is the right size.

words.englishDefinition: Not supporting or favoring either side in a war, dispute, or contest
words.japaneseExplanation: 論争、コンテストまたは戦争でどちらの側の援護もしない、支持しないさま。
words.example: Ziri tried to keep a neutral face as he spoke about that.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing or indicative of high or elevated character
words.japaneseExplanation: 高いか高尚な性質を持つ、示す、または暗示しているさま。
words.example: What a noble heart that good man has!

words.englishDefinition: Belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術的な開発の初期の段階に属するさま。単純さと（しばしば）未熟さによって特徴づけられる。
words.example: You think that your language is more primitive.

words.englishDefinition: Far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
words.japaneseExplanation: 関連性、関係または緊密性においてかけ離れた。
words.example: We can open the car using a remote control.

words.englishDefinition: Speak with others about (something); talk (something) over in detail; have a discussion
words.japaneseExplanation: （何か）について他と話す。（何か）について詳細に議論する。
words.example: We used to discuss everything and now we can't talk about anything.

words.englishDefinition: Travel to or penetrate into
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行するか、侵入する。
words.example: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.

words.englishDefinition: Identify as in botany or biology, for example
words.japaneseExplanation: 例えば、植物学または生物学で特定する。
words.example: I don't want to identify myself with that group.

words.englishDefinition: Give a performance (of something)
words.japaneseExplanation: （何かの）公演をする。
words.example: I do not like to perform in front of others.

words.englishDefinition: Make a prediction about; tell in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 予言をする。前もって予見する。
words.example: I won't try to predict the future.

words.englishDefinition: Deem to be
words.japaneseExplanation: そうであると考える。
words.example: Do you know what I think in this regard?

words.englishDefinition: Require as useful, just, or proper
words.japaneseExplanation: 有用、正当、または適切であるため欠かせない。
words.example: We know doing that will require a lot of money.

words.englishDefinition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
words.japaneseExplanation: 追加する（に対して）。加わるか、組み合わさるか、または他と結合する。
words.example: We didn't need to add flowers to the car to make it beautiful.

words.englishDefinition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをさし示したり、どこかへ行かせる（打撃、兵器、カメラの道具など）。
words.example: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.

words.englishDefinition: to produce young animals; to raise animals for breeding
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物が子を産むことや、繁殖させること。
words.example: Some birds breed here during the summer months.

words.englishDefinition: Demand payment
words.japaneseExplanation: 支払いを要求する。
words.example: I think you should charge $30 an hour.

words.englishDefinition: Give food to
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物を与える。
words.example: I don't think we have enough food to feed everyone.

words.japanese: 氾濫する・水浸しにする
words.englishDefinition: Cover with liquid, usually water
words.japaneseExplanation: 液体で覆う、通常水。
words.example: The heavy rains caused the river to flood.

words.englishDefinition: A story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
words.japaneseExplanation: 神話上のまたは超自然の存在または出来事についての物語。
words.example: I can make you a legend.

words.englishDefinition: Time available for ease and relaxation
words.japaneseExplanation: くつろぎとリラックスのための時間。
words.example: What do they do with all their leisure time?

words.englishDefinition: The branch of philosophy that analyzes inference
words.japaneseExplanation: 推論を分析する哲学の分野。
words.example: I cannot follow your logic.

words.englishDefinition: Cases used to carry belongings when traveling
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行のとき持ち物を運ぶのに用いる箱。
words.example: I don't carry much luggage when I travel by plane.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性よりむしろ道楽を目的としたもの。
words.example: I told her that we couldn't afford such a luxury.

words.englishDefinition: Cosmetics applied to the face to improve or change your appearance
words.japaneseExplanation: 外見をよくしたり変えたりするために顔に塗る化粧品。
words.example: I wash my face every evening to get my makeup off.

words.englishDefinition: Any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
words.japaneseExplanation: 皮膚がほぼ毛で覆われている、温血脊椎動物。単孔類の小亜綱を除いて子供は生きたまま生まれミルクで育てられる。
words.example: What is the largest mammal in the world?

words.englishDefinition: A small handbook
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さなハンドブック。
words.example: Do you know how to drive a manual car?

words.englishDefinition: The message that is intended or expressed or signified
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図されたまたは表現されたメッセージ。
words.example: What is the meaning of this sentence?

words.englishDefinition: Any admirable quality or attribute
words.japaneseExplanation: 賞賛すべき特質や属性。
words.example: I don't know that there's any great merit in that.

words.englishDefinition: A person whose material wealth is valued at more than a million dollars
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質的な富が100万ドル以上と評価される人。
words.example: I wonder what it would be like to be a millionaire.

words.englishDefinition: Solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition
words.japaneseExplanation: 個々の化学組成を持つ、自然界において見出される固体で均質な無機物。
words.example: I always carry a bottle of mineral water with me.

words.englishDefinition: a very small model or copy of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 実物よりずっと小さく作られた模型や複製。
words.example: We saw a miniature of the castle at the museum.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area
words.japaneseExplanation: 都市または人口稠密な地域に関連があるか、に関する。
words.example: We live in an urban area.

words.englishDefinition: Continuing forever without end
words.japaneseExplanation: 果てしなく永遠に続くこと。
words.example: My dream man is endlessly playing hide-and-seek with me.

words.englishDefinition: At a previous time
words.japaneseExplanation: 前回に。
words.example: I didn't study Berber formerly.

words.englishDefinition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
words.japaneseExplanation: それは、誠実に本当である。
words.example: I quite frankly don't know.

words.englishDefinition: Not easy to believe
words.japaneseExplanation: 容易には信じられない。
words.example: I just had something incredibly strange happen to me.

words.englishDefinition: At the beginning
words.japaneseExplanation: 初めのところで。
words.example: I initially had trouble understanding what he was saying.

words.englishDefinition: With pride; in a proud manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 誇りを持って。誇り高い態度で。
words.example: He proudly wore the green star.

words.englishDefinition: Several time
words.japaneseExplanation: 数回。
words.example: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.

words.englishDefinition: Not often
words.japaneseExplanation: めったにない。
words.example: We often have to start again, but seldom from the beginning.

words.englishDefinition: To a small degree or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さい程度か範囲に。
words.example: I speak French only slightly better than I speak English.

words.englishDefinition: For some unspecified reason
words.japaneseExplanation: ある明細化されていない理由で。
words.example: I don't have much money, but I can get along somehow.

words.englishDefinition: With regard to technique
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術に関して。
words.example: My answer was not technically a lie.

words.englishDefinition: For a limited time only; not permanently
words.japaneseExplanation: 限られた期間だけ。永続しない。
words.example: I was only hired temporarily.

words.englishDefinition: Determine the result of (a competition)
words.japaneseExplanation: （競争）の結果を決定する。
words.example: You can judge people by the company they keep.

words.englishDefinition: Like better; value more highly
words.japaneseExplanation: より好む。より高く評価する。
words.example: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out.

words.englishDefinition: Examine minutely or intensely
words.japaneseExplanation: 緻密にまた強烈に調べる。
words.example: I want you to scan this book.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo or be subjected to
words.japaneseExplanation: 耐える、またはさらされる。
words.example: I don't see why we should have to suffer.

words.englishDefinition: Have an effect upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響を及ぼす。
words.example: We must not allow these problems to affect the project.

words.englishDefinition: Present reasons and arguments
words.japaneseExplanation: 理由と論拠を提示する。
words.example: I don't want to argue in front of the children.

words.englishDefinition: Express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 苦情、不満、不快または不幸を表現する。
words.example: I actually have a lot to complain about in my life.

words.englishDefinition: Find fault with; express criticism of; point out real or perceived flaws
words.japaneseExplanation: 非難する。批評を表す。
words.example: I am free to criticize the US.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be slowed down or delayed
words.japaneseExplanation: 減速させられる、または遅延させられる。
words.example: I don't think we should delay doing that any longer.

words.englishDefinition: Bring to a destination, make a delivery
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的地に持ってくる、引き渡す。
words.example: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.

words.englishDefinition: Request urgently and forcefully
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊急に、そして、力強く要請する。
words.example: I demand to see the manager.

words.englishDefinition: Oppose, as in hostility or a competition
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦争行為または競争などにおいて敵対する。
words.example: I couldn't leave you alone to face the danger by yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Win something through one's efforts
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
words.example: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

words.englishDefinition: A person appointed to a high office in the government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の高い地位に任命される人。
words.example: I spoke to the minister himself.

words.englishDefinition: A group of representatives or delegates
words.japaneseExplanation: 代表者や使節のグループ。
words.example: How dangerous do you think this mission is going to be?

words.japanese: 動機・モチベーション
words.englishDefinition: The psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体が望む目的に向かって行動を起こすように仕向ける心理学的特性。行動の理由。
words.example: You give me the motivation to keep going when things become tough.

words.englishDefinition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
words.example: We need a strong person to lead our nation.

words.englishDefinition: Anything indispensable
words.japaneseExplanation: 不可欠な何でも。
words.example: We understand the necessity of studying.

words.englishDefinition: A discussion intended to produce an agreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 合意を目指した議論。
words.example: We want to break off this negotiation.

words.englishDefinition: A source of materials to nourish the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体を養うための材料の源。
words.example: In your opinion, what does good nutrition look like?

words.englishDefinition: A contestant that you are matched against
words.japaneseExplanation: 対抗している競争相手。
words.example: My opponent was stronger than I was.

words.englishDefinition: The place where something begins, where it springs into being
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが生まれて、始まる場所。
words.example: I would like to know your origin.

words.englishDefinition: An established line of travel or access
words.japaneseExplanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
words.example: Please show me the path to the bus stop.

words.englishDefinition: The pointed top of a mountain, or the highest point of something.
words.japaneseExplanation: 山の頂上、または物事の最も高い点。
words.example: Can you see that mountain with the snow-covered peak?

words.englishDefinition: Any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
words.japaneseExplanation: 直感や推理よりも感覚を通じて知る状態や過程。
words.example: We have never managed to explain that phenomenon.

words.englishDefinition: A belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school
words.japaneseExplanation: 一部のグループまたは流派によって権威があると認められている信念（または信念の体系）。
words.example: I agree with that philosophy.

words.englishDefinition: And nothing more
words.japaneseExplanation: そして、多くは何もない。
words.example: You should never look down on a person merely because he is poor.

words.englishDefinition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
words.japaneseExplanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
words.example: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or used in chemistry
words.japaneseExplanation: 化学で使用されるまたはそれに関係する。
words.example: Everyone knows that new chemical is bad for you.

words.englishDefinition: Contrived by art rather than nature
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然ではなくむしろ人為的に考案された。
words.example: I don't like artificial flowers.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
words.japaneseExplanation: 太陽あるいは太陽のエネルギーを利用するものに関する、またはから生じた。
words.example: We must make the best use of solar energy.

words.englishDefinition: Enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 穏やかな気持ちで辛い境遇に耐える、もしくはそのような我慢強さが特徴の。
words.example: Please be patient with me today.

words.englishDefinition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
words.example: I went to a public garden to rest.

words.englishDefinition: Obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 入手または利用可能で、使用またはサービスの準備が整っている。
words.example: How much power do we have available?

words.englishDefinition: With considerable certainty; without much doubt
words.japaneseExplanation: かなりの確信を持って。あまり疑いなく。
words.example: We all hope that's true, but we think it likely isn't.

words.englishDefinition: Having the same or similar characteristics
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じものまたは類似した特徴を持つ。
words.example: We are so similar and so different at the same time.

words.englishDefinition: Having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑いまたは不確実性を持たないか感じないさま。自信があって確実な。
words.example: I feel better now, I could no longer keep certain things inside.

words.englishDefinition: Having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual
words.japaneseExplanation: 特殊の区別または性質を持たない。広く知られたまたは一般に知られた。
words.example: I had no idea we had so much in common.

words.englishDefinition: Unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、サイズ、量、度数、特に程度または範囲において大きな。
words.example: We could be making a huge mistake here.

words.englishDefinition: Win something through one's efforts
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
words.example: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

words.englishDefinition: Refuse to acknowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 認めることを拒む。
words.example: I don't think that you can ignore this problem anymore.

words.englishDefinition: To rest in a flat position, or to be located somewhere.
words.japaneseExplanation: 横になっていること、またはある場所に位置すること。
words.example: I want you to lie still for a few hours.

words.englishDefinition: Be successful; achieve a goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功している。目的を達成する。
words.example: I think we can manage that.

words.englishDefinition: Be equal or harmonize
words.japaneseExplanation: 等しくなる、または調和する。
words.example: Please help me choose a hat to match my new dress.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo a chemical reaction; react with another substance under certain conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 化学反応が起こる。一定の条件下で別の物質と反応する。
words.example: I didn't know how to react to that.

words.englishDefinition: Be fully aware or cognizant of
words.japaneseExplanation: 十分に認知しているまたは認識している。
words.example: I think it's important to realize that may not happen.

words.englishDefinition: Be able to spare or give up
words.japaneseExplanation: 容赦するか、やめることができない。
words.example: I wish I'd been able to afford a better car.

words.englishDefinition: Have an existence, be extant
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在を持つ、存在する。
words.example: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.

words.englishDefinition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
words.example: I don't think I'll be able to fix your broken phone.

words.englishDefinition: Make reference to
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及を行う。
words.example: I am not going to mention the name of the teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Act against or in opposition to
words.japaneseExplanation: それに対して、あるいは反対して行う。
words.example: I hope you're not going to oppose me.

words.englishDefinition: Win a victory over
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝利を収める。
words.example: You can overcome your problems.

words.englishDefinition: An expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence
words.japaneseExplanation: 文の文法的な構成要素を形成する、1つ以上の単語から成る表現。
words.example: Could you read this phrase and translate it into your languages?

words.englishDefinition: A licensed medical practitioner
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可された医者。
words.example: I want to be a physician in the future.

words.englishDefinition: The science of matter and energy and their interactions
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質とエネルギーとその相互作用の科学。
words.example: I cannot understand the physics teacher. I am completely lost!

words.englishDefinition: Extensive tract of level open land
words.japaneseExplanation: 平らで開けた土地の広範囲に及ぶ地帯。
words.example: You can talk to him in plain English and he still won't get it.

words.englishDefinition: A leader engaged in civil administration
words.japaneseExplanation: 行政の指導的立場にある人。
words.example: What that politician said is not at all true.

words.englishDefinition: The allotment of some amount by dividing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを分割することでいくらかの量を割り当てること。
words.example: Our portion has been eaten.

words.englishDefinition: A dense crowd of people
words.japaneseExplanation: 人のひどい混雑。
words.example: We asked him to face the press but he refused to.

words.englishDefinition: A basic or essential attribute shared by all members of a class
words.japaneseExplanation: ある種類のメンバー全てによって共有される基本的、あるいは不可欠な属性。
words.example: How many of the trees on your property are fruit trees?

words.englishDefinition: The quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分の大きさを全体の大きさで割った時に得られる商。
words.example: The proportion of girls to boys in our class is three to two.

words.englishDefinition: One of four equal parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 4等分の1つ。
words.example: Do you have a quarter I could borrow?

words.englishDefinition: The act of receiving
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け取る行為。
words.example: Please wait a moment while I write out your receipt.

words.englishDefinition: An authoritative rule
words.japaneseExplanation: 権威のある規則。
words.example: We should do away with this regulation.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being held in high esteem and honor
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に尊敬され称えられていること。
words.example: You have something of a reputation.

words.englishDefinition: Having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功したか、または良好な結果によって特徴づけられる。
words.example: I hope that your business trip to France was successful.

words.englishDefinition: Financially secure and safe
words.japaneseExplanation: 金融的に堅実で安全な。
words.example: I just want to get home safe and sound.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
words.japaneseExplanation: 統一で特徴づけられる。単一体であるまたはそれに加わる。
words.example: You must be more united than ever.

words.englishDefinition: Of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図的に整列しているが統一性に欠ける多くの異なった種類。
words.example: I really like studying various languages at the same time.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring in or belonging to the present time
words.japaneseExplanation: 今現在に起こるか、属しているさま。
words.example: I can’t take time off for a trip with my current pay.

words.englishDefinition: Involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球全体を含むさま。制限のない、偏狭でない領域。
words.example: We are all part of the global economy.

words.englishDefinition: Being or characteristic of a single thing or person
words.japaneseExplanation: 一つのものまたは人であること、の特徴。
words.example: We must respect the will of the individual.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance; having no positive features
words.japaneseExplanation: 否定、否認、反対または抵抗により特徴付けられるか、または示すさま。肯定的な特性を持たないこと。
words.example: What is one negative thing your last boss say about you?

words.englishDefinition: Temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間的な感覚。過去と未来の中間で。
words.example: You must live in the present, not in the past.

words.englishDefinition: The single one of its kind
words.japaneseExplanation: その種類の唯一のもの。
words.example: I didn't realize how unique that was until I grew up.

words.englishDefinition: Suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
words.japaneseExplanation: 快適さまたは目的またはニーズに適している。
words.example: Please come to meet me some time when it's convenient.

words.englishDefinition: (of a church) given official status as a national or state institution
words.japaneseExplanation: （教会について）国家または州の機関として公式の地位を与えられた。
words.example: What is the official language of your country?

words.englishDefinition: Causing or capable of causing harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 害を起こすことのできるまたは起こす。
words.example: Too much of anything is harmful.

words.englishDefinition: Win approval or support for
words.japaneseExplanation: 承認か支持を勝ち取る。
words.example: You won't be able to persuade me to support you.

words.englishDefinition: Put into print
words.japaneseExplanation: 印刷に入れる。
words.example: I haven't had the time these days to publish it.

words.englishDefinition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
words.japaneseExplanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
words.example: Do you know how hard we worked to raise you?

words.englishDefinition: Do duty or hold offices; serve in a specific function
words.japaneseExplanation: 職務を遂行する、または在職する。具体的な機能に奉仕する。
words.example: I do not want you to serve me.

words.englishDefinition: Have in common
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通に持つ。
words.example: I would like to share a short story with you.

words.englishDefinition: Tolerate or accommodate oneself to
words.japaneseExplanation: 許容するか、順応する。
words.example: I didn't want his help, but I had to accept it.

words.englishDefinition: Announce publicly or officially
words.japaneseExplanation: 公に、または公式に発表する。
words.example: We plan to announce details about our plan tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Come into sight or view
words.japaneseExplanation: 見えてくるかあるいは見える。
words.example: My father is to appear on TV tonight.

words.englishDefinition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
words.example: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Knock against with force or violence
words.japaneseExplanation: 力や暴力にぶつかる。
words.example: I happened to bump into her on the train.

words.englishDefinition: Feel concern or interest
words.japaneseExplanation: 気遣う、あるいは興味を示す。
words.example: You don't seem to care about anything.

words.englishDefinition: Come or bring to a finish or an end
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕上げるあるうは終わりにくるあるいはそれをもたらす。
words.example: I will complete what he started.

words.englishDefinition: Direct one's attention on something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに注意を向ける。
words.example: You must concentrate your attention on what you are doing.

words.englishDefinition: A drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving
words.japaneseExplanation: 考え方や行動の仕方が急激に広範囲に変わること。
words.example: How do you think that this revolution got under way?

words.englishDefinition: A person employed to represent a business and to sell its merchandise (as to customers in a store or to customers who are visited)
words.japaneseExplanation: ビジネスを意味して、その商品（店の顧客対する、または、訪ねられた顧客に）を売るために雇用される人。
words.example: My wife is a salesperson, but she's not working at the moment.

words.englishDefinition: A mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue
words.japaneseExplanation: 傷を負った組織の癒えによって残されたマーク（通常、皮膚で）。
words.example: How did you get that scar on your left hand?

words.englishDefinition: The appearance of a place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所の外観。
words.example: I feel like I've seen this scenery somewhere before.

words.englishDefinition: A distinctive odor that is pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりとした快いにおい。
words.example: I can't forget the scent of his hair.

words.englishDefinition: Financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
words.japaneseExplanation: 学問をしやすいように学生に与えられる経済的援助。
words.example: I was thinking I'd get a scholarship somewhere.

words.englishDefinition: An unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation
words.japaneseExplanation: 刺激に対する直接的で基本的な認知。
words.example: I could never have imagined such a sensation.

words.englishDefinition: Meat of edible aquatic invertebrate with a shell (especially a mollusk or crustacean)
words.japaneseExplanation: 殻をもつ食用水棲無脊椎動物の肉（特に軟体動物や甲殻類）。
words.example: What's your favorite kind of shellfish?

words.englishDefinition: The ability to see; the visual faculty
words.japaneseExplanation: 見る能力。視覚の機能。
words.example: My sight isn't as good as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Something reduced to its minimal form
words.japaneseExplanation: その最小の形になる何か。
words.example: Do you have the skeleton key?

words.englishDefinition: Something that causes great unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな不幸を引き起こすもの。
words.example: I know my sorrow won’t set me free.

words.englishDefinition: A reminder of past events
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去の出来事を思い出させるもの。
words.example: I bought you a souvenir, but I ate it.

words.englishDefinition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon
words.japaneseExplanation: 4つの等しい辺と4つの直角がある平面長方形。4面の正多角形。
words.example: Can you find the area of this square?

words.englishDefinition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
words.japaneseExplanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
words.example: I don't think Tom is the right person for this particular job.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with actual use or practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 実際の使用または実行に関心を持つ。
words.example: I have no practical reason for learning this language.

words.englishDefinition: Easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚によって容易に知覚される、または心によって理解される。
words.example: I think that it's very obvious what's going to happen.

words.englishDefinition: Not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に質、能力、大きさまたは度合において例外的ではない。
words.example: How many times do you laugh in an ordinary day?

words.englishDefinition: Associated with academia or an academy
words.japaneseExplanation: 学究的な世界かアカデミーと関連付けられる。
words.example: How can I improve my academic writing?

words.englishDefinition: Conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確に、または、ほぼ正確に事実あるいは規格に従うか、完全な正確さで実行するさま。
words.example: How accurate do you think this report is?

words.englishDefinition: Belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に西のローマ帝国の没落の前の歴史の期間の遠い過去時間に属するさま。
words.example: What was life like for children back in ancient history?

words.englishDefinition: (of a surface) not written or printed on
words.japaneseExplanation: （表面について）書かれていない、または印刷されていない。
words.example: My mind went blank when I saw her.

words.englishDefinition: expected or scheduled to happen at a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: 到着や出来事などが予定されていること。
words.example: The next train is due in five minutes.

words.englishDefinition: Being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間または努力または実費を浪費することなく効果的であるさま。
words.example: I am not so efficient as I used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Applying to all or most members of a category or group
words.japaneseExplanation: カテゴリやグループのすべてかほとんどの構成要素に適用するさま。
words.example: I love all animals in general.

words.englishDefinition: Having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 実質または具体的な存在があるさま。感覚で認識できる。
words.example: We cannot ask anything about age or physical problems.

words.englishDefinition: Affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜びを与えるさま。あなたの趣味または好みと調和してあること。
words.example: We went to the party and had a pleasant time.

words.englishDefinition: Use up (resources or materials)
words.japaneseExplanation: （資源または材料）使い果たす。
words.example: I am not allowed to consume sugar.

words.englishDefinition: Determine the number or amount of
words.japaneseExplanation: 数か量を測定する。
words.example: I know I can count on every one of you.

words.englishDefinition: Give a description of
words.japaneseExplanation: 描写を行う。
words.example: How do you think that your friends would describe you?

words.englishDefinition: to reduce the usual price of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品などの通常の価格を下げること。
words.example: The shop will discount these shoes next week.

words.englishDefinition: Give to a charity or good cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 慈善団体または立派な大義名分に与える。
words.example: What do I need to do to donate my blood?

words.englishDefinition: Consider unlikely or have doubts about
words.japaneseExplanation: ありそうもないと思うか、疑いがある。
words.example: I know you have reason to doubt me.

words.englishDefinition: Engage or hire for work
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
words.example: I will employ the girl, because she can speak French.

words.englishDefinition: Extend in scope or range or area
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲、幅または領域が広がる。
words.example: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

words.englishDefinition: To cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :"She forced him to take a job in the city"
words.japaneseExplanation: 圧力または必要性を通じてさせることで、身体的、道徳的、または、知的な手段によって行う：。
words.example: I could force you to do that, but I won't.

words.englishDefinition: Assemble or get together
words.japaneseExplanation: 集まるか、集合する。
words.example: We need to gather everyone together.

words.englishDefinition: Heal or recover
words.japaneseExplanation: 癒す、または回復する。
words.example: What should I do to heal my broken leg?

words.englishDefinition: Have as a necessary feature
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な特徴として有する。
words.example: We need to involve the family in this decision.

words.englishDefinition: to cause a living thing to die
words.japaneseExplanation: 生き物の命を奪うこと。植物や細菌にも使う。
words.example: Too much water can kill some indoor plants.

words.englishDefinition: Workplace for the teaching or practice of an art
words.japaneseExplanation: 技芸を教えたり練習したりする場所。
words.example: I found you a studio.

words.englishDefinition: A residential district located on the outskirts of a city
words.japaneseExplanation: 都市のはずれにある住宅地。
words.example: He lives in a suburb, in a quiet suburb.

words.englishDefinition: A quantity obtained by the addition of a group of numbers
words.japaneseExplanation: 一群の数の加算によって得られる量。
words.example: How large a sum did they raise?

words.englishDefinition: A meeting of heads of governments
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の首脳たちの会談。
words.example: I reached the summit of the mountain in exactly five hours.

words.japanese: 周囲の（名詞「周囲の状況・環境」は通常 surroundings）
words.englishDefinition: located around a particular place or thing
words.japaneseExplanation: 形容詞では「周囲の」。名詞で「周囲の状況・環境」を表す場合は通常 surroundings を使う。
words.example: We explored the surrounding countryside during our trip.

words.englishDefinition: An arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance
words.japaneseExplanation: 慣習的な意味を獲得した任意の（書かれたまたは印刷された）記号。
words.example: I give you this ring as a symbol of my love.

words.englishDefinition: The posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に、胴体または体の中心を超えたところまで延び、広がっているの脊椎動物の体の後部分。
words.example: We need to move, I have the police on my tail.

words.englishDefinition: Someone whose occupation involves training in a specific technical process
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の技術工程における訓練を伴う職業の人。
words.example: What time does the technician arrive?

words.englishDefinition: Place of worship consisting of an edifice for the worship of a deity
words.japaneseExplanation: 神聖な礼拝のための建築物からなる崇拝の場所。
words.example: I don't know what the name of that temple is.

words.englishDefinition: (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神的または感情的な緊張または不安の状態。
words.example: You could feel the tension in the air.

words.englishDefinition: The geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
words.japaneseExplanation: 主権国家の管轄下の地理的な領域。
words.example: It goes with the territory.

words.englishDefinition: The act of moving something from one location to another
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所から別の場所へ何かを運ぶ行為。
words.example: Do you know how to get there by public transportation?

words.englishDefinition: A general tendency to change (as of opinion)
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的に変化する傾向の（意見などで）。
words.example: I don't think that it's a trend.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or displaying affirmation or acceptance or certainty etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 肯定、容認、または確信などが特徴の、またはそれらを見せるさま。
words.example: I try to be positive all the time.

words.englishDefinition: (used especially of persons) of the immediate past
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に人々に使用される）すぐ前の過去の。
words.example: What did you like the most about your previous job?

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of reliance or trust
words.japaneseExplanation: 信頼または信用にふさわしい。
words.example: How reliable do you think this information is?

words.englishDefinition: Not quite exact or correct
words.japaneseExplanation: あまり正確でないか正しくない。
words.example: I was going through a rough time.

words.englishDefinition: previously owned or used by someone else
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかの人が以前に使っていた中古の物を表す。
words.example: I bought a secondhand bicycle from a friend.

words.englishDefinition: Intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 度合いまたは質において、極度にまたは非常に悪いまたは不快な。
words.example: I have a severe pain here.

words.englishDefinition: Very small
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に小さい。
words.example: We are on a small planet with little countries with tiny people.

words.englishDefinition: Having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に使用または交換にとって優れた物的価値または金銭的価値を持っているさま。
words.example: I am sorry to have taken up your valuable time.

words.englishDefinition: Having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
words.japaneseExplanation: お金あるいは価値のある財産の潤沢な供給があるさま。
words.example: I was born into a wealthy family.

words.englishDefinition: Serving or used in place of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の物の代わりとして役立つ、または使用される。
words.example: Can you give me another alternative?

words.englishDefinition: (sometimes followed by 'of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識、理解、実感または知覚を持つ、あるいは示す。
words.example: I wasn't aware that I had to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Most important element
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も重要な要素。
words.example: Our chief want in life is somebody who shall make us do what we can.

words.englishDefinition: Applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
words.japaneseExplanation: 軍隊とは対照的に普通の市民に適用するさま。
words.example: I will write him a civil answer.

words.englishDefinition: to arrange things or plan an event
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を整理したり、行事を準備したりすること。
words.example: We need to organize the school festival together.

words.englishDefinition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
words.example: I don't know how to prove that I love you.

words.englishDefinition: Turn away from; give up
words.japaneseExplanation: 拒否する。やめる。
words.example: I made up my mind to quit smoking from now on.

words.englishDefinition: Refuse entrance or membership
words.japaneseExplanation: 入ることまたは一員であることを拒否する。
words.example: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.

words.englishDefinition: Have confidence or faith in
words.japaneseExplanation: 信用、または信頼する。
words.example: I don't think we should rely on Tom too much.

words.englishDefinition: Force, take, or pull apart
words.japaneseExplanation: 強制的に分ける、分解する、あるいは引き離す。
words.example: I don't want to separate myself from the team.

words.englishDefinition: Change from one vehicle or transportation line to another
words.japaneseExplanation: ある乗り物または輸送機関から他の物へ乗り換える。
words.example: I haven't got any money on me, but I can transfer.

words.englishDefinition: Forsake, leave behind
words.japaneseExplanation: 見放す、置き去りにする。
words.example: We had to abandon the car.

words.englishDefinition: Make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
words.japaneseExplanation: 宣伝する。売ろうとする（製品を）。
words.example: I think I will advertise in the paper.

words.englishDefinition: Move towards
words.japaneseExplanation: そこに向かって動く。
words.example: I told him never to approach my son again.

words.englishDefinition: to organize and carry out an activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 調査や実験などを計画して実行すること。
words.example: Our class will conduct a survey about school lunches.

words.englishDefinition: Give careful consideration to
words.japaneseExplanation: よく考える、慎重審議する。
words.example: Please give me a little more time to consider that.

words.englishDefinition: Fall or come down violently
words.japaneseExplanation: 落ちる、あるいは激しく下降する。
words.example: What caused the plane to crash?

words.englishDefinition: Trying something to find out about it
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを試みて、そのことに関する情報を得る。
words.example: You have 30 days left in your 30-day free trial.

words.englishDefinition: An orderly crowd
words.japaneseExplanation: 整然とした群衆。
words.example: We saw a troop of monkeys moving from tree to tree.

words.englishDefinition: A succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence
words.japaneseExplanation: 特徴的な配列を形成する音符の継承。
words.example: I know the tune, but I don't know the words.

words.englishDefinition: An unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの不利な状況に悩む不幸な人。
words.example: You don't have to be a victim.

words.englishDefinition: (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きている宿主の細胞内のみでそれ自身を複製する極微の感染性の病原菌。多くは病原性である。
words.example: I think I have a virus on my computer.

words.englishDefinition: A listing of the words used in some enterprise
words.japaneseExplanation: ある仕事で使われる単語のリスト。
words.example: You can create a vocabulary list to learn new words.

words.englishDefinition: The amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object
words.japaneseExplanation: 物体によって占められている立体空間の量。
words.example: Please turn down the volume a little bit more.

words.englishDefinition: Something that remunerates
words.japaneseExplanation: 報いるもの。
words.example: My wife helps me to spend my wage.

words.englishDefinition: Annual or biennial grass having erect flower spikes and light brown grains
words.japaneseExplanation: 直立する穂状花序と明るい褐色の穀粒を持つ、一年生または二年生の草。
words.example: I have not eaten wheat in two months.

words.englishDefinition: An injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin)
words.japaneseExplanation: 生体組織の損傷（特に皮膚の切り傷、ひび割れなどの怪我）。
words.example: My friend died from a wound.

words.englishDefinition: Someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が系統を引く（通常、祖父母よりも遠い）人。
words.example: How do you know your ancestors even lived where you do now?

words.englishDefinition: A feeling of craving something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを切望する気持ち。
words.example: I built up an appetite while watching him make dinner.

words.englishDefinition: A demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together
words.japaneseExplanation: 両手を叩くことによる承認の表明。
words.example: I do it for the applause.

words.englishDefinition: Difficult to analyze or understand
words.japaneseExplanation: 分析または理解が難しい。
words.example: My brother could not solve the complicated problem.

words.japanese: どちらでも、どちらかの
words.englishDefinition: the one or the other of two
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つのうちのどちらか、またはどちらでもよいことを表す。
words.example: You can use either pen for the test.

words.englishDefinition: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
words.japaneseExplanation: （植物相または動物相について）絶滅の差し迫った危険な状態である。
words.example: What makes you think that your language is endangered?

words.englishDefinition: Of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能な限りの程度、範囲、強度の。
words.example: I hear you've done some pretty extreme stuff.

words.englishDefinition: Involving financial matters
words.japaneseExplanation: 財政問題にかかわるさま。
words.example: I am once again asking for your financial support.

words.englishDefinition: Easily agitated
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮しやすい。
words.example: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

words.englishDefinition: Not commercially motivated
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業的に動機づけられない。
words.example: My nonprofit has a hands on approach to problem solving.

words.englishDefinition: Moving or facing away from each other
words.japaneseExplanation: お互いから避け、離れる。
words.example: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: In the recent past
words.japaneseExplanation: 最近において。
words.example: I get the feeling I'm sleeping too much recently.

words.englishDefinition: Used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
words.japaneseExplanation: 人が述べられた事実に対してその正反対であると予想するのを含意するために用いられる。意外にも。
words.example: Do you have any idea who actually wrote this letter?

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: 加えて。
words.example: I woke up next to an unknown girl again. Moreover, she isn't ugly at all this time.

words.englishDefinition: To some (great or small) extent
words.japaneseExplanation: ある（多い、または、少ない）程度において。
words.example: I don't feel good or rather, I feel terrible.

words.englishDefinition: By bad luck
words.japaneseExplanation: あいにく。
words.example: I would like to be there, but unfortunately I cannot.

words.englishDefinition: Be on the defensive; act against an attack
words.japaneseExplanation: 守勢に立っている。攻撃に対する行為。
words.example: I looked for something I could use to defend myself.

words.englishDefinition: Separate into parts or portions
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分や部分に分かれる。
words.example: I thought you were going to divide up work.

words.englishDefinition: Run away from confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁から逃げる。
words.example: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

words.englishDefinition: Observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
words.japaneseExplanation: 観察、確かめる、入念に調べるまたは検査する。
words.example: I want to examine you again tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Exchange or replace with another, usually of the same kind or category
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のものと交換する、取り替える、通常同じ種類またはカテゴリーのものと。
words.example: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

words.englishDefinition: Bring into existence
words.japaneseExplanation: 生まれ出る。
words.example: We're trying to generate business.

words.englishDefinition: Fix or set securely or deeply
words.japaneseExplanation: 確実に、または、深く固定するあるいは設置する。
words.example: Tom is considering a tooth implant after losing one of his front teeth in an accident.

words.englishDefinition: Put together out of artificial or natural components or parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 人工または自然の構成要素あるいは部品から組立てられる。
words.example: We don't manufacture anything any more.

words.englishDefinition: Make believe with the intent to deceive
words.japaneseExplanation: だます意図でふりをする。
words.example: You don't need to pretend that you still like me.

words.englishDefinition: Let for money
words.japaneseExplanation: 金のために貸す。
words.example: We want to rent an apartment in the city.

words.englishDefinition: Express the need or desire for; ask for
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性かは欲求を表わす。要求する。
words.example: I have a serious request to make of you.

words.englishDefinition: Return to life; get or give new life or energy
words.japaneseExplanation: 生き返る。新しい生命またはエネルギーを得るか、与える。
words.example: Do you know an artist who can restore this old picture for me?

words.japanese: 生き残る、存在し続ける
words.englishDefinition: Continue to live through hardship or adversity
words.japaneseExplanation: 苦難または逆境を通して生き続ける。
words.example: We can survive without food... just not for too long.

words.englishDefinition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
words.example: I don't think I have enough money to pay the bill.

words.englishDefinition: A document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 述べられている事実が真実であることを証明する文書。
words.example: I wonder where I can use this gift certificate.

words.englishDefinition: An assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business
words.japaneseExplanation: 司法業務を行うための集まり（1人以上の裁判官を含む）。
words.example: My friends stood by me during the court case.

words.englishDefinition: The metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在使われている金属ないしは紙でできた交換媒介物。
words.example: What is the currency of your country?

words.englishDefinition: A concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
words.japaneseExplanation: 単語、句、記号の意味の簡潔な説明。
words.example: You can see that definition here, under sense three.

words.englishDefinition: A discrimination between things as different and distinct
words.japaneseExplanation: 異なって違ったものとしての、物事の間の区別。
words.example: I can make a distinction between good and bad.

words.englishDefinition: Players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
words.japaneseExplanation: プレーヤーは、チャンスを買い（または与えられ）、賞は、くじを引いて分配される。
words.example: I finally finished a drawing that I started about a month ago.

words.englishDefinition: A violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
words.japaneseExplanation: 化学や核反応によるエネルギーの激しい放出。
words.example: I want to know what caused the explosion.

words.englishDefinition: An erroneous mental representation
words.japaneseExplanation: 誤った心的表象。
words.example: I think it's an illusion.

words.englishDefinition: Something that results
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果として生じる何か。
words.example: I am not planning to tell you the outcome at all.

words.englishDefinition: A person who travels by foot
words.japaneseExplanation: 徒歩で旅行する人。
words.example: I try to use the pedestrian bridge in order to exercise.

words.englishDefinition: A distinctive odor that is pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりとした快いにおい。
words.example: I decided not to buy the perfume anymore.

words.englishDefinition: A basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であると受け入れられ、理論や行動の基本とすることができる、基礎的な概念。
words.example: What is the principle reason for going to school?

words.englishDefinition: Advancing in amount or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 量または強さが進歩すること。
words.example: I increasingly need your help.

words.englishDefinition: With sincerity; without pretense
words.japaneseExplanation: 誠実さをもって。見せかけなしで。
words.example: I sincerely hope that never happens to him.

words.englishDefinition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
words.example: I think we're going to eventually have to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
words.example: You are doing exactly what they want you to do.

words.englishDefinition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
words.japaneseExplanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
words.example: I was nearly run over by a car.

words.englishDefinition: For the most part
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分。
words.example: My success was mainly due to your help.

words.englishDefinition: And nothing more
words.japaneseExplanation: そして、多くは何もない。
words.example: I asked him several times, but he simply didn't reply.

words.englishDefinition: In truth (often tends to intensify)
words.japaneseExplanation: 実は（しばしば強調につながる）。
words.example: You believe he is a good doctor, and he is indeed.

words.englishDefinition: With rapid movements
words.japaneseExplanation: 急速な動きで。
words.example: I learn new ideas rapidly.

words.englishDefinition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
words.example: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

words.englishDefinition: To or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage ('further' is used more often than 'farther' in this abstract sense)
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きな程度までに、またはより進んだ段階までに。
words.example: How about we discuss this situation further tomorrow morning, if you like?

words.englishDefinition: Almost not
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんどない。
words.example: I don't like fish very much and hardly ever eat it.

words.englishDefinition: Despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
words.japaneseExplanation: それと反対（通常、譲歩に続く）な何にもかかわらずでも。
words.example: I slept for ten hours, nevertheless I'm still tired.

words.englishDefinition: Disturb the balance or stability of
words.japaneseExplanation: バランスまたは安定性を妨げる。
words.example: I hope I didn't do anything to upset you.

words.englishDefinition: Alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確性を得るため、または基準に従うため変える、あるいは調節する。
words.example: Please adjust the seat to fit you.

words.englishDefinition: Consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的な特徴か意味を発見するために、詳細に検討し分析する。
words.example: I want you to analyze this.

words.englishDefinition: Put into a proper or systematic order
words.japaneseExplanation: 適切な、または規則正しい順番に並べる。
