words.example: I want you to arrange a meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Give help or assistance; be of service
words.japaneseExplanation: 助けたり援助する。役立つ。
words.example: I wonder if you can assist me.

words.englishDefinition: Prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に法的手段または社会的圧力によって禁止する。
words.example: I have good reason to ban him from using the computer.

words.englishDefinition: Put up with something or somebody unpleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快な何かまたは誰かを我慢する。
words.example: I don't think I can bear this pain much longer.

words.englishDefinition: Make a mathematical calculation or computation
words.japaneseExplanation: 数学的演算や計算をする。
words.example: I must calculate how much money I'll spend next week.

words.englishDefinition: Hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of
words.japaneseExplanation: 制止する、の危険のようなあるいは敵のように。それの拡張または影響を確認する。
words.example: I decided to go back to check whether I'd locked the door.

words.englishDefinition: Make by combining materials and parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料および部品を合成して作る。
words.example: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.

words.englishDefinition: Work together on a common enterprise of project
words.japaneseExplanation: 計画の共同作業を一緒にする。
words.example: We are working hard to cooperate more.

words.japanese: 次第である、当てにする
words.englishDefinition: Be contingent upon (something that is elided)
words.japaneseExplanation: （削除されたもの）次第である。
words.example: I need to know that I can depend on you.

words.englishDefinition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
words.japaneseExplanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
words.example: Our eyes can detect light.

words.englishDefinition: An unvarying or habitual method or procedure
words.japaneseExplanation: 変わらないか習慣的方法または手順。
words.example: You have a routine on Monday, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: Gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: （通例真実とうそを取り混ぜた）ゴシップが口コミで広まっていくこと。
words.example: I know better than to be believe such a rumor.

words.englishDefinition: A specific form of evildoing
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪行の特定の形式。
words.example: He would leave the job to his vice president.

words.englishDefinition: An energetic style
words.japaneseExplanation: 活力にあふれた態度。
words.example: My brother had a great deal of vitality for his age.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who pays for goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品やサービスにお金を払う人。
words.example: I hope that we don't lose you as a customer.

words.englishDefinition: A physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons
words.japaneseExplanation: 静止したあるいは動いている電子と陽子に関連した物理的現象。
words.example: You didn't forget to pay the electricity bill, did you?

words.englishDefinition: A piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
words.japaneseExplanation: 実存する状況、または発生した出来事についての情報。
words.example: You must state the fact as it is.

words.englishDefinition: The totality of surrounding conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 総体的な周囲の状況。
words.example: We do not respect the environment as much as we should.

words.englishDefinition: A quantity of money
words.japaneseExplanation: 貨幣量。
words.example: I don't know how to pay you this amount of money.

words.englishDefinition: space available for someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物を入れられる空間や余裕。この意味では不可算名詞。
words.example: Is there room in your bag for this book?

words.englishDefinition: an explanation or set of ideas about how something works
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事の仕組みを説明する考え方や理論。科学では証拠に支えられた体系的な説明。
words.example: We discussed a theory about how children learn languages.

words.englishDefinition: A search for knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識を得るための調査。
words.example: Our company wants to take part in that research project.

words.englishDefinition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
words.japaneseExplanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
words.example: Can you tell me when I can have the results of the test?

words.englishDefinition: By chance
words.japaneseExplanation: 偶然に。
words.example: I thought perhaps no one else would agree with me.

words.englishDefinition: With considerable certainty; without much doubt
words.japaneseExplanation: かなりの確信を持って。あまり疑いなく。
words.example: We probably won't be able to move this without some help.

words.englishDefinition: although; despite the fact that
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜だけれども」と、予想と違う事実をつなぐ。
words.example: Though it was raining, we still enjoyed the trip.

words.englishDefinition: during the time that; in contrast with
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
words.example: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

words.englishDefinition: except if
words.japaneseExplanation: 「もし〜でなければ」を表す。if ... not に近い意味。
words.example: We will play outside unless it rains.

words.englishDefinition: every time that; at any time that
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜するときはいつでも」「〜するたびに」を表す。
words.example: You can ask me whenever you need help.

words.englishDefinition: on the condition that
words.japaneseExplanation: provided that で「〜という条件で」。条件を示すやや硬い表現。
words.example: You can borrow my bike provided you return it today.

words.englishDefinition: in or to any place that
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜する所ならどこでも」を表す。
words.example: You can sit wherever you feel comfortable.

words.englishDefinition: used to show a contrast between two facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つの事実を「一方では」と対比する接続詞。
words.example: I prefer tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.

words.englishDefinition: during the whole of a period; in every part of a place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある期間の最初から最後まで、または場所の全体にわたること。
words.example: The library is open throughout the summer vacation.

words.englishDefinition: about or relating to
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜について」「〜に関して」を表すやや硬い前置詞。
words.example: I have a question concerning tomorrow's meeting.

words.englishDefinition: without being prevented by something
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
words.example: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) any sensation or change in bodily function that is experienced by a patient and is associated with a particular disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 患者により経験され、特定の疾患に関連する身体の機能における感覚または変化。
words.example: Do you have this symptom often?

words.englishDefinition: Fix in scope; fix the boundaries of
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲において確定する。境界を決定する。
words.example: We should determine what is to be done first.

words.englishDefinition: To show, make visible or apparent
words.japaneseExplanation: 見せるために、可視化する、またはか明らかにする。
words.example: You all display similar behavior.

words.englishDefinition: Institute, enact, or establish
words.japaneseExplanation: 設ける、制定するあるいは設立する。
words.example: I will establish myself as a lawyer.

words.englishDefinition: Extend in one or more directions
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つまたはそれ以上の方向に伸ばす。
words.example: Our company wants to expand into a new market.

words.englishDefinition: Make full, also in a metaphorical sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 比喩的な感覚においても、いっぱいにする。
words.example: I am going to fill you up so full.

words.englishDefinition: Predict in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 前もって予言する。
words.example: Do you know what the weather forecast is for tomorrow?

words.englishDefinition: Change to ice
words.japaneseExplanation: 氷への変化。
words.example: Please freeze the fish and meat.

words.englishDefinition: Prevent from being seen or discovered
words.japaneseExplanation: 見られる、または発見されるのを防ぐ。
words.example: We need to find a place to hide this money.

words.englishDefinition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
words.example: We should invent a secret language.

words.englishDefinition: to kill a person intentionally and unlawfully
words.japaneseExplanation: 故意に違法に人の命を奪うことを表す動詞。
words.example: In the story, the detective discovers who murdered the victim.

words.japanese: に注意する、書き留める
words.englishDefinition: Observe with care or pay close attention to
words.japaneseExplanation: 慎重に観測するか、または細心の注意を払う。
words.example: Please note that the price is subject to change.

words.englishDefinition: Share in something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かにおいて共有する。
words.example: I hope you will participate in many of them.

words.englishDefinition: Make impure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不潔にする。
words.example: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.

words.englishDefinition: A worker who is hired to perform a job
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事をするために雇われた労働者。
words.example: I am an employee at a company.

words.englishDefinition: The piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがある（予定の）土地の区画。
words.example: I just started using this site a little while ago.

words.englishDefinition: The aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: ある特殊の時間内に特殊の場所で物が行き来する寄り合い状態。
words.example: We made good time since the traffic was light.

words.englishDefinition: How a result is obtained or an end is achieved
words.japaneseExplanation: いかにして、ある結果が得られたり、ある目的が達成されたりするかということ。
words.example: I can't tell you how much this means to me.

words.englishDefinition: Logical or comprehensible arrangement of separate elements
words.japaneseExplanation: グループの個々の要素を論理的にわかりやすくい配列したもの。
words.example: We received the order yesterday, but haven't filled it yet.

words.englishDefinition: An activity or gift that benefits the public at large
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会全般のためになる活動もしくは贈り物。
words.example: I got these shoes from a charity shop for £2.

words.englishDefinition: Something that aids or promotes well-being
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸福を助け、推進する何か。
words.example: I want to give you the benefit of the doubt.

words.englishDefinition: A medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists
words.japaneseExplanation: 医療専門家のグループによって運営される医療機関。
words.example: How often do you go to a hospital or a clinic?

words.englishDefinition: A person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な知識や能力を持ち、巧みに遂行する人。
words.example: I don't need to be an expert. I just know.

words.englishDefinition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
words.example: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

words.englishDefinition: A way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを行う方法、特に体系的なもの。秩序だって理論的な（通常、段階を進んでいく）方法を意味する。
words.example: I can say from experience that this method works.

words.englishDefinition: An instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
words.japaneseExplanation: 課題あるいはサービスを実行するのに必要な物。
words.example: We had a little trouble with the equipment yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: A plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人あるいは社会的グループによって採用されている計画あるいは活動。
words.example: I think we need to change our policy on that.

words.englishDefinition: Involving only main features
words.japaneseExplanation: 主要な特徴だけを伴うさま。
words.example: I think that overall we're in good shape.

words.englishDefinition: In accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle
words.japaneseExplanation: 一定の命令または手順または原則に従って。
words.example: I don't have a regular job.

words.englishDefinition: Living in or characteristic of farming or country life
words.japaneseExplanation: 農業や田園の生活を送る、またはそれらに特有の。
words.example: You will soon be used to rural life.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities
words.japaneseExplanation: 遊びまたはつまらないことよりも仕事または重要な事柄に関心のある。
words.example: You don't seem to realize how serious this is.

words.englishDefinition: Happening without warning or in a short space of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 何の前触れもなく、または短い時間に起こるさま。
words.example: What made you change your mind all of a sudden?

words.englishDefinition: Meant or adapted for an occasion or use
words.japaneseExplanation: 出来事または使用が意味される、または構成される。
words.example: Can you find suitable time for our meeting?

words.englishDefinition: Exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category
words.japaneseExplanation: グループまたは種類またはカテゴリーを確認する特性または特徴を示すさま。
words.example: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.

words.englishDefinition: having a particular value or being useful enough
words.japaneseExplanation: 価値があること。worth doing で「〜する価値がある」。
words.example: This museum is definitely worth a visit.

words.englishDefinition: Suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人か場所、条件などにふさわしい。
words.example: We did not think her loud dress was appropriate for the time and place.

words.englishDefinition: Typical or distinctive
words.japaneseExplanation: 典型的であるか特徴的な。
words.example: A green color is a characteristic of that type of apple.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture
words.japaneseExplanation: 早期の文明とその文化で最も高度な発達段階の、または、早期の文明とその文化で最も高度な発達段階に関する。
words.example: We love classical music the most.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to commercialism
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業主義に関する、またはそれの。
words.example: I went to a commercial high school.

words.englishDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
words.example: I think it's cruel to keep a cat inside.

words.englishDefinition: Hold back to a later time
words.japaneseExplanation: しばらく隠しておく。
words.example: We had to postpone the game because of rain.

words.englishDefinition: Express approval of
words.japaneseExplanation: 好意的な感情を表す。
words.example: You cannot praise a child enough for doing something well.

words.englishDefinition: Contribute to the progress or growth of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か成長に貢献する。
words.example: I am not going to promote any religion.

words.englishDefinition: Utter words of protest
words.japaneseExplanation: 抗議の言葉を吐く。
words.example: We have to protest against it.

words.japanese: 関連づける、関連がある
words.englishDefinition: Be relevant to
words.japaneseExplanation: 関連している。
words.example: You find it hard to relate to women.

words.englishDefinition: Release, as from one's grip
words.japaneseExplanation: 掴んでいるものなどを、解放する。
words.example: I told him not to release the rope, but he let it go.

words.englishDefinition: Free from harm or evil
words.japaneseExplanation: 危害または不正から開放する。
words.example: I hope someone comes to rescue us.

words.japanese: 予約する、を取っておく
words.englishDefinition: Hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に将来使うために、または不足の事態に備えて隠しておく、または蓄えておく。
words.example: We would like to reserve a table for 6 o'clock.

words.englishDefinition: Flow, run or fall out and become lost
words.japaneseExplanation: 流れる、抜け落ちてそしてなくなる。
words.example: I am afraid he is going to spill the beans.

words.englishDefinition: Treat with excessive indulgence
words.japaneseExplanation: 過度の甘さで扱う。
words.example: Do you want to spoil the best moment in my life?

words.englishDefinition: Stick to firmly
words.japaneseExplanation: しっかり執着。
words.example: We three will stick together.

words.englishDefinition: Extend one's limbs or muscles, or the entire body
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の手足または筋肉または体の全体を伸ばす。
words.example: We got out of the car to stretch our legs.

words.japanese: 成功する、を成し遂げる
words.englishDefinition: Attain success or reach a desired goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功を収めるか、または望んでいる目標に達する。
words.example: We had expected that you would succeed this time.

words.englishDefinition: A conveyance that transports people or objects
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物を運ぶ乗物。
words.example: How did that vehicle end up here?

words.englishDefinition: The essential qualities or characteristics by which something is recognized
words.japaneseExplanation: それによって何かが認められる必須の特性または特徴。
words.example: What is the nature of time?

words.englishDefinition: A message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 述べられたまたは言い切られたメッセージ。詳細や事実などについて述べる（口頭、または書面の）コミュニケーション。
words.example: I don't think that anyone would agree with that statement.

words.englishDefinition: An occurrence of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの発生。
words.example: I thought they were the same, but it looks like that's not the case.

words.englishDefinition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
words.example: I have some experience in that area as well.

words.englishDefinition: A change of position that does not entail a change of location
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所の変化を伴わない体勢の変化。
words.example: Does he have something in common with this movement?

words.englishDefinition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
words.japaneseExplanation: 異種交配できる分類群。
words.example: I had never before seen this species of fish.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of having a superior or more favorable position
words.japaneseExplanation: より優った、あるいはより好ましい位置を保つという特質。
words.example: You have an advantage over him.

words.englishDefinition: Food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)
words.japaneseExplanation: （台所などから）捨てられる食べ物。
words.example: I saw a man yesterday eating from a garbage can.

words.englishDefinition: A decorative or artistic work
words.japaneseExplanation: 装飾的芸術的作品。
words.example: Do you see a pattern here?

words.englishDefinition: The force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit)
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面の単位面積に働く力。パスカル（国際表示単位）またはダイン（CGS単位）で測定される。
words.example: I couldn't handle the pressure anymore and I gave up.

words.englishDefinition: Elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に海水面または地表からの高さ。
words.example: I don't feel well at such a high altitude.

words.englishDefinition: A specialized division of a large organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな組織の専門化された部門。
words.example: I got a new hat at the department store.

words.englishDefinition: having a disability that may affect everyday activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 障害のある状態を表す。施設や社会の対応について話すときにも使う。
words.example: The new ramp improves access for disabled visitors.

words.englishDefinition: Suitable to or characteristic of drama
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇に適した、または劇に特有の。
words.example: I think you're being a bit over-dramatic.

words.englishDefinition: Using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
words.japaneseExplanation: 効果を得るために必要な最小限の時間または資源を使用する。
words.example: Bread with oil is a very healthy and economical food.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、範囲、量、力、または程度が異常に大きい。
words.example: The work took an enormous amount of time to finish.

words.englishDefinition: Constituting the full quantity or extent; complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 全数量か範囲を構成するさま。完全なさま。
words.example: I can't pay attention to the entire world at once!

words.englishDefinition: Absolutely necessary; vitally necessary
words.japaneseExplanation: 絶対に必要なさま。きわめて必要であるさま。
words.example: I think that it's absolutely essential.

words.englishDefinition: no longer existing as a living species
words.japaneseExplanation: その種の生き物が一頭も残っていないこと。
words.example: The dodo became extinct hundreds of years ago.

words.englishDefinition: Fraudulent; having a misleading appearance
words.japaneseExplanation: いかさまの。紛らわしい外観をした。
words.example: You don't need to be perfect, just don't be fake.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of being changed
words.japaneseExplanation: 変わることができる。
words.example: My body isn't as flexible as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Not fake or counterfeit
words.japaneseExplanation: まやかしや偽物ではない。
words.example: I think William is one of the most genuine people I've ever met.

words.englishDefinition: Uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般に無学の。知識あるいは高い教養が不足していること。
words.example: I just realized that I'm quite ignorant about the world.

words.englishDefinition: Free from external control and constraint
words.japaneseExplanation: 外部の支配と制約がない。
words.example: How many independent countries are there in the world?

words.englishDefinition: Disposed or inclined toward
words.japaneseExplanation: 気が向いた、または傾向がある。
words.example: I can't pay you. Are you still willing to help?

words.englishDefinition: to look at different pages on the internet
words.japaneseExplanation: インターネットのページを次々に見て回ること。
words.example: I sometimes surf the internet for new recipe ideas.

words.englishDefinition: to occupy someone's attention completely
words.japaneseExplanation: be absorbed in で「〜に夢中になっている」。
words.example: I was so absorbed in my book that I missed lunch.

words.japanese: 達成する、を成し遂げる
words.englishDefinition: To gain with effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で得る。
words.example: I don't understand what you want to achieve with that.

words.englishDefinition: Declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であることを宣言するあるいは存在、現実あるいは真実を認める。
words.example: I have to admit that he is right.

words.englishDefinition: Contribute to the progress or growth of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か成長に貢献する。
words.example: I wanted to advance, but the job really went nowhere.

words.englishDefinition: Cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快感にさせる。特に小さな苛立ちによって、妨げる。
words.example: I never allow what can't be changed to annoy me.

words.englishDefinition: to ask strongly for help or a decision
words.japaneseExplanation: 援助などを強く求めること。appeal to someone for help の形で使う。
words.example: The school appealed to parents for help with the event.

words.englishDefinition: Make an effort or attempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力する、または試みる。
words.example: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?

words.englishDefinition: Give, especially as an honor or reward
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に名誉または報酬として、与える。
words.example: I would like to thank many people for helping me win this award, but I won't.

words.englishDefinition: Broadcast over the airwaves, as in radio or television
words.japaneseExplanation: 放送波に乗せて放送する、ラジオまたはテレビのように。
words.example: What language does this radio station broadcast in?

words.englishDefinition: Postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
words.japaneseExplanation: 予定されていたものを、無期限に延期する、または取り消す。
words.example: We had to cancel the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Put or add together
words.japaneseExplanation: まとめる、あるいは足し合わせる。
words.example: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.

words.japanese: (芸術・音楽など)を創作する
words.englishDefinition: Produce a literary work
words.japaneseExplanation: 文学作品を作り出す。
words.example: He took a moment to compose himself.

words.englishDefinition: Writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を提供する文書（特に公式自然の情報）。
words.example: Please send this document before the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
words.japaneseExplanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
words.example: We were all surprised at the effect the news had on him.

words.englishDefinition: A distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list
words.japaneseExplanation: リスト上で列挙される物も集団で別々に特定できる独立した部分。
words.example: How long have you and your girlfriend been an item?

words.englishDefinition: The number of inhabitants (either the total number or the number of a particular race or class) in a given place (country or city etc.)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある土地（国または町など）の住人（総計または特定の民族、階級の数）の数。
words.example: How large is the population of this city?

words.englishDefinition: The particular portion of space occupied by something
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物質によって占められている空間的な部分。
words.example: Do you think he is good for the position?

words.englishDefinition: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律で罰せられる行為。通常悪い行為と見なされる。
words.example: I just said what I thought. Is that a crime?

words.englishDefinition: An isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体から分離して考えられる独立した事実。
words.example: I guess we should go over the details at some point.

words.englishDefinition: The organized action of making of goods and services for sale
words.japaneseExplanation: 販売用の商品やサービスを製造、提供する組織的な活動。
words.example: What do you like the most and least about working in this industry?

words.englishDefinition: Someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い期間特定の場所に、または生まれた場所に住んでいる人。
words.example: I'm a resident of Boston.

words.englishDefinition: The outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
words.japaneseExplanation: 物体の外側の境界、または境界となるあるいはそれに似た物質の層。
words.example: I saw several fish swimming near the surface of the water.

words.englishDefinition: A doctor who practices veterinary medicine
words.japaneseExplanation: 家畜診療を行う医師。
words.example: We had to go to the veterinarian with our dog.

words.englishDefinition: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
words.japaneseExplanation: 核分裂により生産される葉緑素のない単細胞、非細胞球形、渦巻き状の、あるいは棒状の有機体。病原菌として、および生化学の特性のために重要である。
words.example: You must make the bacteria inside you happy.

words.englishDefinition: The act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)
words.japaneseExplanation: （たとえばスケッチや略図を描いたり、プランを立てたりすることによって）何かの形を案出する行為。
words.example: I like this design more than the other one.

words.englishDefinition: Impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
words.japaneseExplanation: 見ることが不可能、またはほぼ不可能。目で感知できない。
words.example: I am an invisible man.

words.englishDefinition: Having reached full natural growth or development
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全な自然の成長または発達に達したさま。
words.example: I think our son is mature enough to understand it.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦争の原則の研究の、または、戦争の原則の研究に関する。
words.example: I cannot train with the military.

words.englishDefinition: The least possible
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も可能性の低い。
words.example: I can barely pay the minimum every month.

words.englishDefinition: Being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme
words.japaneseExplanation: 妥当な、または標準的な範囲内にある。過剰でないか極端でない。
words.example: I thought you were a moderate.

words.englishDefinition: Having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚または知性に明確でない意味を持つ。普通の理解を越えて。
words.example: I have never seen such a mysterious book.

words.englishDefinition: Existing in possibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能性の中で存在する。
words.example: I think that there's some real potential here.

words.englishDefinition: Estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較により査定される。絶対でないか完全でない。
words.example: I have a relative who lives around here.

words.englishDefinition: Serving to represent or typify
words.japaneseExplanation: 代表する、または典型となる。
words.example: I am the legal representative for the company.

words.englishDefinition: continuing for or considering a short period
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い期間に限られることや、短期的な視点を表す。
words.example: This is only a short-term solution to the problem.

words.englishDefinition: Important in effect or meaning
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響あるいは意味において重要な。
words.example: I desire to make a significant change in my life.

words.japanese: ストレスの原因となる
words.englishDefinition: Extremely irritating to the nerves
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に神経に障る。
words.example: We have a stressful day ahead of us.

words.englishDefinition: having length, width, and height
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さ・幅・高さがある立体的なこと。
words.example: We made a three-dimensional model of our classroom.

words.englishDefinition: Assemble without order or sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 順序または分別なく集まる。
words.example: I want to be understood. I don't want to confuse anyone.

words.englishDefinition: to be made up of particular things
words.japaneseExplanation: consist of で、何から構成されているかを表す。
words.example: The course consists of ten weekly lessons.

words.englishDefinition: Change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy
words.japaneseExplanation: あるシステムからもう一つのまたは新らしい計画または制作へ変化する。
words.example: My parents tried to convert me to their way of thinking.

words.englishDefinition: Argue with one another
words.japaneseExplanation: お互いに議論する。
words.example: We will debate this subject at the meeting.

words.japanese: 衰える、傾く、丁重に断る
words.englishDefinition: Grow smaller
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さくなる。
words.example: I intend to decline his offer to help me.

words.japanese: に断る 失望させる、がっかりする
words.englishDefinition: Fail to meet the hopes or expectations of
words.japaneseExplanation: 希望または期待に添うことができない。
words.example: I hope you're not going to disappoint me.

words.japanese: りする迷惑をかける、邪魔をする
words.englishDefinition: Destroy the peace or tranquility of
words.japaneseExplanation: 平和または静けさを破壊する。
words.example: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.

words.japanese: をするもてなす、楽しませる
words.englishDefinition: Provide entertainment for
words.japaneseExplanation: エンターテイメントを提供する。
words.example: I need to entertain myself with something.

words.englishDefinition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
words.japaneseExplanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
words.example: I estimate that the work will cost more than $10,000.

words.englishDefinition: Give expression to
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現をする。
words.example: I can't find the word to express what I feel.

words.englishDefinition: Be in motion due to some air or water current
words.japaneseExplanation: 微風または水流によって動いている。
words.example: I love to float on the water.

words.englishDefinition: Be later in time
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間的により遅い。
words.example: We always have to follow the rules.

words.englishDefinition: Receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
words.japaneseExplanation: 勉強の完了で学位を受ける。
words.example: I want my children to graduate from high school.

words.englishDefinition: An instrumentality invented for a particular purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的のために発明された道具。
words.example: I don't know when you must turn off the device.

words.englishDefinition: A print made by an impression of the ridges in the skin of a finger; often used for biometric identification in criminal investigations
words.japaneseExplanation: 指の皮膚の隆起した線の印象によって作られた跡。犯罪捜査において、人物特定のためにしばしば使用される。
words.example: The first thing that caught his eye was a fingerprint on the glass.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that can be consumed to produce energy
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを生み出すために消費される物質。
words.example: How much fuel do you need?

words.englishDefinition: The collection of rules imposed by authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 行政当局によって課された規則の集まり。
words.example: I do not respect the law.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is remembered
words.japaneseExplanation: 覚えていること。
words.example: My memory failed me. I just couldn't remember his name.

words.englishDefinition: Available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 財貨を生じる源。必要なときに引き出せる新しい、または貯蓄された供給源。
words.example: We don't have the resources we need.

words.englishDefinition: A detailed critical inspection
words.japaneseExplanation: 細目にわたる批判的な検査。
words.example: Please take our survey today.

words.englishDefinition: Noticeable heterogeneity
words.japaneseExplanation: 目立つ異種性。
words.example: You can catch a variety of fish while fishing.

words.englishDefinition: A state at a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: 一定の時の状況。
words.example: I will run under the condition that it's not raining.

words.englishDefinition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: I wonder what I did to upset that creature.

words.englishDefinition: The tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object
words.japaneseExplanation: 物の構成に費やされる、触れることのできる物質。
words.example: I want a suit made of this material.

words.englishDefinition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
words.example: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who supports or champions something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを支援、または擁護する人。
words.example: My sponsor was willing to agree to my suggestion.

words.englishDefinition: Disposed or inclined toward
words.japaneseExplanation: 気が向いた、または傾向がある。
words.example: I can't pay you. Are you still willing to help?

words.englishDefinition: very unreasonable or silly
words.japaneseExplanation: 理屈に合わず、ばかげていること。
words.example: That price is absurd for such a small sandwich.

words.englishDefinition: Having a strong desire for success or achievement
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功または達成のための強い欲求を持っているさま。
words.example: I used to be young and ambitious, just like you.

words.englishDefinition: happening once every year
words.japaneseExplanation: 一年に一回行われること、または一年間に関すること。
words.example: Our annual school festival takes place in October.

words.englishDefinition: Causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
words.japaneseExplanation: 心配を示す、それで一杯のまたはそれを引き起こす。
words.example: I get anxious waiting for a friend for a long time.

words.englishDefinition: Clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
words.japaneseExplanation: 心や感覚、または判断にはっきりと表される。
words.example: It was apparent that there was no way out.

words.englishDefinition: Using or knowing two languages
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの言語を使うか、知っているさま。
words.example: I wonder if bilingual people have a favorite language.

words.englishDefinition: Of short duration or distance
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い期間または距離の。
words.example: What he said was brief and to the point.

words.englishDefinition: Have the skills and qualifications to do things well
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事をよく行う技術および資格を持っている。
words.example: Do you believe that people are capable of change?

words.japanese: ひんやりする、寒気のする
words.englishDefinition: Appreciably or disagreeably cold
words.japaneseExplanation: 目に見えて、または、不愉快に冷たい。
words.example: My room is really good, though a little bit chilly.

words.englishDefinition: Complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 構造が複雑な。相互に連結された部品から成ること。
words.example: What seems simple to you seems complex to me.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚によって感知されることができる。抽象的でないまたは非実在的でない。
words.example: What do you intend to do with the concrete?

words.englishDefinition: Intentionally conceived
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図的に考えられた。
words.example: I became more health-conscious and started to go on walks.

words.englishDefinition: Guess correctly; solve by guessing
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しく推量する。推測することによって、解決する。
words.example: I will guess the number.

words.englishDefinition: Engage or hire for work
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
words.example: How many more people do we need to hire?

words.japanese: 感心させる、(良い)印象を与える
words.englishDefinition: Have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情的であるか認識影響を及ぼす。
words.example: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.

words.japanese: 与える設置する、インストールする
words.englishDefinition: Set up for use
words.japaneseExplanation: 使用するために置く。
words.example: Do you want me to install it for you?

words.englishDefinition: Destroy the peace or tranquility of
words.japaneseExplanation: 平和または静けさを破壊する。
words.example: Please don't interrupt me when I am speaking.

words.englishDefinition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
words.example: I became unable to maintain my self-control.

words.englishDefinition: Be or become completely proficient or skilled in
words.japaneseExplanation: 十分に熟達している、に熟練した、あるいは、になる。
words.example: I tried to master English for more than ten years, but I failed!

words.japanese: (食品・原料など)加工処理する
words.englishDefinition: Subject to a process or treatment, with the aim of readying for some purpose, improving, or remedying a condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの目的のための準備、向上するため、または状態を改善することを伴う過程または処理を受けさせる。
words.example: I need some time to process what happened.

words.japanese: 提案する、結婚を申し込む
words.englishDefinition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
words.example: I have made up my mind to propose to her.

words.englishDefinition: Obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction
words.japaneseExplanation: 購入によって得る。金融取引によって取得する。
words.example: We will purchase a new car next week.

words.englishDefinition: Be a mystery or bewildering to
words.japaneseExplanation: 神秘か目まぐるしい。
words.example: I don't have a solution to this puzzle.

words.englishDefinition: Build again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び構築する。
words.example: I have enough money to rebuild the house.

words.englishDefinition: Seek information from
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を集める。
words.example: I can refer you to a good book on this subject.

words.englishDefinition: A committee having supervisory powers
words.japaneseExplanation: 監視の権限を持つ委員会。
words.example: I moved a chess piece on the board one forward.

words.englishDefinition: a large amount, usually in the phrase a great deal
words.japaneseExplanation: 量を表す用法では a great deal of で「大量の」「多くの」。
words.example: We spent a great deal of time on this project.

words.englishDefinition: The act of making up your mind about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かについて心を決める行為。
words.example: We have to stay a decision until he comes back.

words.englishDefinition: The act of discovering something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを発見する行為。
words.example: I was surprised at the discovery.

words.englishDefinition: A fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services
words.japaneseExplanation: 専門的な業務について請求される固定料金。
words.example: What kind of food do your feed your children?

words.englishDefinition: A room or series of rooms where works of art are exhibited
words.japaneseExplanation: 芸術作品が展示される部屋、または一連の部屋。
words.example: You should drop by his gallery if you have time.

words.englishDefinition: The act of making something publicly available; presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを一般に公表する行為。ニュースまたは他の情報を放送あるいは印刷物で提示すること。
words.example: I prepared a presentation for this very lesson.

words.englishDefinition: The place where some action occurs
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが起こった場所。
words.example: I went to the scene of the crime.

words.englishDefinition: A specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
words.japaneseExplanation: 義務として、あるいは、特定の料金のために行うことを要求される特定の仕事。
words.example: We will all work together to finish this task on time.

words.englishDefinition: A fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving
words.japaneseExplanation: 裁縫や編み物に使われる撚った繊維（綿、絹、毛、ナイロンなど）の細いひも。
words.example: I lost the thread of the story.

words.englishDefinition: A series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end
words.japaneseExplanation: ある考えを推し進める、またはある目的に向かっていこうとする一連の活動。
words.example: How do you think that the campaign is going?

words.englishDefinition: An abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 3つの同素形が存在する豊富な非金属の4価元素：非晶質炭素、石墨、およびダイヤモンド。すべての有機化合物に存在する。
words.example: You are the carbon they want to reduce.

words.englishDefinition: (biology) the basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; they may exist as independent units of life (as in monads) or may form colonies or tissues as in higher plants and animals
words.japaneseExplanation: すべての生き物の形態的・機能的基本単位。それらは（単細胞生物のように）独立した生命単位として存在することもあり、またはより高等な植物や動物のように集落や組織を形成することもある。
words.example: We won't be able to get out of this cell.

words.englishDefinition: wanting to know or learn about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を知りたいと思う、好奇心のある状態。
words.example: I'm curious about how this machine works.

words.englishDefinition: Difficult to handle; requiring great tact
words.japaneseExplanation: 扱いづらい。優れた如才なさを要するさま。
words.example: How should we handle this delicate situation?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the home
words.japaneseExplanation: 家庭の、または、家庭に関する。
words.example: I prefer to buy domestic rather than foreign products.

words.englishDefinition: Emitting or reflecting very little light
words.japaneseExplanation: 光をほとんど出さない、または反射しない。
words.example: My life would be very dull without books.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing great excitement and interest
words.japaneseExplanation: ものすごい興奮と関心を持つか、示すさま。
words.example: I thought that Tom would be more enthusiastic about that.

words.japanese: 広範囲にわたる、広々とした
words.englishDefinition: Large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間範囲、範囲、領域または量で大きい。
words.example: I was impressed by his extensive knowledge.

words.englishDefinition: Steadfast in affection or allegiance
words.japaneseExplanation: 愛情または忠誠でしっかりとした。
words.example: I wish you always faithful friends at your side.

words.englishDefinition: Smooth and unconstrained in movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 運動において滑らかで無拘束の。
words.example: I can speak a little French, but I'm not fluent.

words.englishDefinition: Not often
words.japaneseExplanation: めったにない。
words.example: We rarely met each other.

words.englishDefinition: Without advance planning
words.japaneseExplanation: 事前計画なしで。
words.example: I accidentally locked my keys in the car.

words.englishDefinition: To an extreme degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 極端に。
words.example: I caught the last train because I walked extremely quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
words.japaneseExplanation: 遅れ、または躊躇なしで。介入する時間なしで。
words.example: I wrote to him that he needs to come immediately.

words.englishDefinition: in or toward the central part of a town or city
words.japaneseExplanation: 町の中心部にあることや、そこへ行くこと。
words.example: Let's take the bus downtown after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: Pay back
words.japaneseExplanation: 返金する。
words.example: Please cancel my order and refund the money.

words.englishDefinition: Reject with contempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽蔑して拒絶する。
words.example: I do not want to reject this claim.

words.englishDefinition: React verbally
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で反応する。
words.example: I don't know how to reply to that question.

words.englishDefinition: Take the place of or be parallel or equivalent to
words.japaneseExplanation: その代わりをする、その類似物である、またはそれと同等のものである。
words.example: What company do you represent?

words.japanese: 暴露する、明らかにする
words.englishDefinition: Make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前数人の人のみに知られていた、または機密にされていたことを意味する公開情報を明らかにする。
words.example: I want to reveal my secret to you.

words.englishDefinition: Increase in value or to a higher point
words.japaneseExplanation: 価値あるいはより高い点が増加する。
words.example: We expect prices to rise in the near future.

words.japanese: 駄目にする、破滅させる
words.englishDefinition: Reduce to ruins
words.japaneseExplanation: 減少して荒廃する。
words.example: You will ruin your health if you drink too much.

words.englishDefinition: Try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of
words.japaneseExplanation: 見つけ、発見し、またはその存在を確定しようとする。
words.example: We don't have time to search the whole area.

words.englishDefinition: Enhance the appearance of
words.japaneseExplanation: 外見を良くする。
words.example: I thought you were going to wear your new suit.

words.englishDefinition: Express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote
words.japaneseExplanation: 候補か測定か解決のための人の好みを表現する。一票を投じる。
words.example: I don't yet know who I'm going to vote for.

words.japanese: 目撃する、証明する、証言する
words.englishDefinition: Be a witness to
words.japaneseExplanation: 目撃者である。
words.example: What should a person do if they are involved in or witness a traffic accident?

words.englishDefinition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
words.example: What do I need to do to get an account?

words.englishDefinition: Take into one's family
words.japaneseExplanation: その人の家族にする。
words.example: I heard that they want to adopt a baby.

words.englishDefinition: Something that interests you because it is important or affects you
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分にとって重要、あるいは影響があるために興味を持たせるもの。
words.example: How does this concern you?

words.englishDefinition: Any of numerous extinct terrestrial reptiles of the Mesozoic era
words.japaneseExplanation: 絶滅した多くの中生代の陸生爬虫類の総称。
words.example: I failed as a person. I'm a dinosaur now.

words.englishDefinition: Your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 信じる、信じないの基礎となるもの。信じることの基礎を形成する知識。
words.example: We have all the evidence against you we need.

words.englishDefinition: Single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の厚さのある種の通例同質の物質。
words.example: I tried the layer cake of my aunt.

words.englishDefinition: How something is done or how it happens
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがされる方法またはそれが起こる方法。
words.example: You can choose between dark mode and light mode.

words.englishDefinition: A symptom of some physical hurt or disorder
words.japaneseExplanation: 肉体的な傷か疾患の症状。
words.example: I can give you some medicine for the pain.

words.englishDefinition: The excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の期間内で出費を超える収益の超過部分（減価償却と他の非現金出費を含む）。
words.example: I sold the house for a profit.

words.englishDefinition: An ability that has been acquired by training
words.japaneseExplanation: 訓練によって身につけた能力。
words.example: I don't have the skill needed to do that.

words.englishDefinition: The place where something begins, where it springs into being
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが生まれて、始まる場所。
words.example: Our source of light is the sun.

words.englishDefinition: A kind of sensing; distinguishing substances by means of the taste buds
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚の一種。味蕾によって物質を区別する。
words.example: I still have the taste of coffee in my mouth.

words.englishDefinition: Clothing in general
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的に衣服。
words.example: My father does not care about his clothes at all.

words.englishDefinition: A group of people living in a particular local area
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通の民族、文化、宗教的な特徴を持つ人々の集団。
words.example: We consider you all a part of the community.

words.englishDefinition: A prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)
words.japaneseExplanation: 相談や情報交換、討論のための事前に取り決められた会議（特に公式の議事日程を持つもの）。
words.example: I want everyone in the conference room tomorrow morning by 8:00.

words.englishDefinition: Many times at short intervals
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
words.example: I frequently have a hard time sleeping at night.

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: 加えて。
words.example: No, no, and furthermore, no!

words.englishDefinition: In a gentle manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 柔らかい態度で。
words.example: He loves to touch his wife gently.

words.englishDefinition: In a gradual manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 段階的な方法で。
words.example: My father is gradually getting better.

words.englishDefinition: During the intervening time
words.japaneseExplanation: 介在する時間内で。
words.example: What will you do meanwhile?

words.englishDefinition: if not; in a different way
words.japaneseExplanation: 「そうでなければ」や「それ以外の点では」を表す。
words.example: Let's leave now. Otherwise, we will miss the train.

words.englishDefinition: In a polite manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 丁寧な物腰で。
words.example: You should have talked more politely.

words.englishDefinition: In the right manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しい方法で。
words.example: I can't hear you properly. Please speak more slowly.

words.japanese: それに応じて、したがって
words.englishDefinition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given
words.japaneseExplanation: あげられた理由のため。
words.example: While I understand what you are saying, I cannot do accordingly.

words.englishDefinition: In a mechanical manner; by a mechanism
words.japaneseExplanation: 機械的な方法で。メカニズムで。
words.example: When you open the door, the light comes on automatically.

words.englishDefinition: To a severe or serious degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 深刻でまたは重大な程度に。
words.example: How badly do they want it?

words.englishDefinition: Without question and beyond doubt
words.japaneseExplanation: 確かにそして紛れもなく。
words.example: You should definitely ask him out.

words.englishDefinition: To the same degree (often followed by 'as')
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ程度に。
words.example: We tried to share the little there was as equally as possible.

words.japanese: 感謝する、正しく評価する
words.englishDefinition: Recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
words.japaneseExplanation: 感謝を表彰する。感謝する。
words.example: I would appreciate any information you can send to us.

words.japanese: 価する割り当てる、配属する
words.englishDefinition: Give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
words.japaneseExplanation: （人）を職に配置する、あるいは（人）に仕事を割り当てる。
words.example: I don't know if the teacher plans to assign homework.

words.japanese: 振る舞う、行儀よくする
words.englishDefinition: Behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の方法で振る舞う。特定の振舞いを示す。
words.example: I don't need you telling me how to behave.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be bored
words.japaneseExplanation: 退屈させる。
words.example: I could go on, but I don't want to bore you.

words.englishDefinition: Force out or release suddenly and often violently something pent up
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然にそして抑圧された何かをしばしば激しく強制的に外に出す、あるいは放出する。
words.example: I want to burst into tears.

words.englishDefinition: Go after with the intent to catch
words.japaneseExplanation: 捕らえる目的で追いかける。
words.example: We knew that the dog would chase the cat.

words.englishDefinition: Break down, literally or metaphorically
words.japaneseExplanation: 文字通り、または、比喩的に壊れる。
words.example: I feel like I'm about to collapse.

words.englishDefinition: Perform an act, usually with a negative connotation
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常否定的な意味合いで、行為を行う。
words.example: You don't need to commit right now.

words.japanese: わせる競争する、匹敵する
words.englishDefinition: Compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かのために競う。競技に参加する。
words.example: We used to compete against each other in college.

words.englishDefinition: Decide by reasoning; draw or come to a conclusion
words.japaneseExplanation: 推論によって決定する。結論を引き出す、または結論にたどり着く。
words.example: I had to conclude he was right.

words.englishDefinition: Establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい証拠または事実などで立証する、または補強する。
words.example: Could you please confirm that for me in writing?

words.japanese: 契約する、 (協定等を)結ぶ
words.englishDefinition: Reduce in scope while retaining essential elements
words.japaneseExplanation: 必須の要素を保持している間、範囲が減少する。
words.example: We would like to sign another contract with you.

words.japanese: )結ぶ一因となる、寄付(貢献)する
words.englishDefinition: Contribute to some cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの原因に貢献する。
words.example: I just wish I could contribute more money.

words.englishDefinition: A distant region
words.japaneseExplanation: 遠くの場所。
words.example: We could see the lights of the town in the distance.

words.englishDefinition: The system of production and distribution and consumption
words.japaneseExplanation: 生産、流通、消費の制度。
words.example: I can't afford much because of the economy we are in.

words.englishDefinition: Earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをしよう、または達成しようとするまじめで良心的な行動。
words.example: Do you think reading this book is worth the effort?

words.englishDefinition: Motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱のエネルギーを機械的な仕事に変換するモータ。
words.example: I got back in my car and started the engine.

words.englishDefinition: A process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物が異なる段階（特により発達した、または成熟した段階）に次第に移行する過程。
words.example: Do you believe in evolution?

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
words.example: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

words.englishDefinition: Approval to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをすることの承認。
words.example: You are not to leave this room without my permission.

words.englishDefinition: Something left after other parts have been taken away
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の部分が取り去られた後に残った物。
words.example: We took a rest one after the other.

words.englishDefinition: Any specific behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の行動。
words.example: What activity do you spend most of your time doing?

words.englishDefinition: A component that is added to something to improve it
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを改善するためにそれに加えられる要素。
words.example: You forgot to put the addition sign here.

words.englishDefinition: A complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のさまでこうどうするための信条、感情、価値および気質を含む複雑な精神状態。
words.example: I hope to improve my attitude to work.

words.englishDefinition: A statistic describing the location of a distribution
words.japaneseExplanation: 分布の位置を表す統計値。
words.example: What is the value of an average home in your area?

words.englishDefinition: A cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
words.japaneseExplanation: 大規模に営利目的で成育される栽培植物。
words.example: We are the cream of the crop!

words.japanese: まあまあ、かなり、公正に
words.englishDefinition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
words.example: I could do that fairly well when I was younger.

words.englishDefinition: In the recent past
words.japaneseExplanation: 最近において。
words.example: I haven't been feeling well lately.

words.englishDefinition: In your mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 心の中。
words.example: How does a mentally ill person get that kind of job?

words.englishDefinition: In large part; mainly or chiefly
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分において。主に、または大方。
words.example: I mostly do not want to think about anything anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Now and then or here and there
words.japaneseExplanation: 時々、あちこち。
words.example: We will visit you occasionally.

words.englishDefinition: By chance
words.japaneseExplanation: 偶然に。
words.example: What can we possibly give them?

words.englishDefinition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
words.example: I can't understand what precisely she wants.

words.englishDefinition: In a stringent manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 厳格に。
words.example: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.

words.japanese: したがって、このように
words.englishDefinition: as a result; in this way
words.japaneseExplanation: 「したがって」「このように」を表すやや硬い副詞。
words.example: We missed the last bus and thus had to walk home.

words.englishDefinition: In a close manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊密なさまの。
words.example: We look forward to working more closely with you in the future.

words.englishDefinition: Without variation or change, in every case
words.japaneseExplanation: いずれの場合にも変化または変更のない。
words.example: I can't live without your love. I think of you constantly.

words.englishDefinition: With eagerness; in an eager manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱意をもって。熱心なようすで。
words.example: I am well aware that many will eagerly argue against my view.

words.japanese: 観察する、 (法などを)守る
words.englishDefinition: Stick to correctly or closely
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しく、またはきっちりと貼りつく。
words.example: I like to observe people.

words.englishDefinition: Make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something
words.japaneseExplanation: （誰かに）真実または何かの有効性を、同意させる、自覚させる、あるいは理解させる。
words.example: I tried to convince myself that he was doing the right thing.

words.englishDefinition: Make smaller
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さくする。
words.example: What should you do to decrease your debt?

words.englishDefinition: Give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人、行動または理由に完全に貢献する。
words.example: I want to dedicate my life to language learning.

words.englishDefinition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
words.example: I don't know how to demonstrate it, since it's too obvious!

words.japanese: 金などを)預ける、置いておく
words.englishDefinition: Put into a bank account
words.japaneseExplanation: 銀行口座に入れる。
words.example: We should deposit this money in a bank.

words.englishDefinition: Be worthy or deserving
words.japaneseExplanation: それにふさわしい、あるいはそれに値する。
words.example: You deserve a break after all your hard work.

words.englishDefinition: Intend (something) to move towards a certain goal
words.japaneseExplanation: （何か）を特定のゴールの方へ進めさせることを狙いとする。
words.example: What movies did he direct?

words.englishDefinition: Mark as different
words.japaneseExplanation: 異なっていると強調される。
words.example: We need to distinguish right from wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Distribute or disperse widely
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く配布するか、分散させる。
words.example: These he used to distribute to his friends.

words.englishDefinition: Earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業またはビジネス取引で稼ぐ。給与または賃金で稼ぐ。
words.example: How much money do you expect to earn next year?

words.englishDefinition: Prepare for publication or presentation by correcting, revising, or adapting
words.japaneseExplanation: 訂正、改訂、あるいは適応により、出版またはプレゼンテーションに備える。
words.example: I need three hours to edit it.

words.englishDefinition: To stress, single out as important
words.japaneseExplanation: 強調するために、重要であるとして選び出す。
words.example: I was born to emphasize out my difference from most other people.

words.englishDefinition: Come together
words.japaneseExplanation: 団結する。
words.example: What kind of animals are you most afraid to encounter?

words.englishDefinition: The act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
words.japaneseExplanation: 管理された試験または調査を行う行為。
words.example: You can't be too careful when doing this experiment.

words.englishDefinition: An instance of traveling by air
words.japaneseExplanation: 飛行機で旅をすること。
words.example: I had to book a flight for him.

words.englishDefinition: Causing something without any direct or apparent effort
words.japaneseExplanation: いかなる直接的または明白な努力なしに、何かを引き起こすこと。
words.example: I believe in the influence of the stars on our lives.

words.englishDefinition: The social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたをその力によって要求された行動方針に結びつける社会的勢力。
words.example: You need to take some responsibility for the problem.

words.englishDefinition: The actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人あるいはグループに割り当てられたり、必要とされたり、期待されたりする行動や活動。
words.example: I think that we have a role to play.

words.englishDefinition: A statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
words.japaneseExplanation: 問題を解く、またはその問題の解き方を説明する言明。
words.example: We spent hours trying to find a solution to the problem.

words.englishDefinition: A practical method or art applied to some particular task
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の仕事に応用する、実践的な方法または技巧。
words.example: I wonder what the advantage of this technique is.

words.englishDefinition: The wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
words.japaneseExplanation: 伐られて、建築資材として使用の準備ができている木。
words.example: The timber is still green.

words.englishDefinition: A long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river
words.japaneseExplanation: 地表の細長いくぼみで、ふつう川になっている。
words.example: We went down to the valley where the village is.

words.englishDefinition: The quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを望ましいもの、重要なものにする（よい意味でも悪い意味でも）特質。
words.example: We need to be aware of the value of time.

words.englishDefinition: The space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians
words.japaneseExplanation: 交差する2本の線または平面の間の空間。1本の線から別の線の傾斜。
words.example: You can't see the TV from your angle.

words.englishDefinition: A gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance
words.japaneseExplanation: （通常は公共の場で）公演を観たり聴いたりする人々の集まり。
words.example: How many people do you think are in the audience?

words.englishDefinition: A person's social heritage: previous experience or training
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の生まれつきの社会的境遇：以前の経験や訓練。
words.example: I like to read with music playing in the background.

words.englishDefinition: Receive a specified treatment (abstract)
words.japaneseExplanation: 指定された処置（抽象的な）を受ける。
words.example: I did everything I could to obtain this price.

words.englishDefinition: Come to pass
words.japaneseExplanation: 起こる。
words.example: I don't expect that to occur.

words.englishDefinition: Perform as expected when applied
words.japaneseExplanation: 適用される際に、予想通りに実行する。
words.example: I can't figure out how to operate this machine.

words.englishDefinition: Interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
words.japaneseExplanation: 継続前に活動を一時的に中断する。
words.example: You need to pause between each sentence.

words.englishDefinition: to display a notice where people can see it
words.japaneseExplanation: お知らせなどを人が見られる場所に掲示すること。
words.example: They will post the results on the notice board tomorrow.

words.japanese: 資格を与える、適任とする
words.englishDefinition: Prove capable or fit; meet requirements
words.japaneseExplanation: 能力がある、または適切であることを証明する。要求に適う。
words.example: You need at least three members to qualify.

words.englishDefinition: To throw or bend back (from a surface)
words.japaneseExplanation: 背中（表面から）を放り投げるあるいは、曲げる。
words.example: I need a little time to reflect upon it.

words.englishDefinition: Become loose or looser or less tight
words.japaneseExplanation: 緩くする、より緩くする、またはきつくなくなる。
words.example: I just want to relax and listen to some music.

words.englishDefinition: Pay back
words.japaneseExplanation: 返金する。
words.example: I only wish there was some way I could repay you.

words.englishDefinition: Make a copy or equivalent of
words.japaneseExplanation: コピーまたは等価物を作る。
words.example: Try to reproduce the music in your mind.

words.englishDefinition: Stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何かに対して立ち上がりまたは抵抗する。
words.example: I don't know if I can resist anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position
words.japaneseExplanation: 隠居する、退職する。その人の仕事を実行するのを止めるあるいは、その人の職務から撤退する。
words.example: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.

words.englishDefinition: Reverse the position, order, relation, or condition of
words.japaneseExplanation: 位置、順序、関係または状態を逆にする。
words.example: We are unable to reverse the process.

words.englishDefinition: Regard something as probable or likely
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
words.example: You can expect me tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Become fixed or fastened
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された、固定される。
words.example: Please fasten your seat belt.

words.englishDefinition: Bend or lay so that one part covers the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 一つの部分が他の部分を覆うように曲げるあるいは置く。
words.example: How many times have I told you to fold your clothes?

words.englishDefinition: Give surety or assume responsibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 確証するまたは責任を引き受ける。
words.example: I can guarantee you that Sami is no longer a problem.

words.englishDefinition: Express or state indirectly
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現するか、間接的に述べる。
words.example: I didn't mean to imply what you did was wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Bring in from abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 外国から持ち込む。
words.example: Do you think we should import rice from the U.S.?

words.englishDefinition: Indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所、方向、人、または物事を指す。空間的または比喩的に。
words.example: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.

words.englishDefinition: Impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to
words.japaneseExplanation: いくつかの事実、状態、情勢、事象についての知識を授ける。
words.example: I wrote to inform him of my decision.

words.englishDefinition: Raise from a lower to a higher position
words.japaneseExplanation: 低い位置から高い位置に上げる。
words.example: I wasn't strong enough to lift the box by myself.

words.englishDefinition: Fill or place a load on
words.japaneseExplanation: 内容物を詰め込むまたは入れる。
words.example: What else do you want to load into the car?

words.englishDefinition: Take in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 嫁にもらう。
words.example: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.

words.japanese: 重大である、問題になる
words.englishDefinition: Have weight; have import, carry weight
words.japaneseExplanation: 重荷になる。重要で、重きを増す。
words.example: You might say that doesn't matter very much, but actually it does.

words.englishDefinition: Keep tabs on; keep an eye on; keep under surveillance
words.japaneseExplanation: 見張る。注視する。
words.example: I am very satisfied with my new computer monitor.

words.englishDefinition: the number one thousand million
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在の一般的な英語では十億を表す。
words.example: More than a billion people live in India.

words.englishDefinition: A division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant
words.japaneseExplanation: 茎が分裂したもの、または植物の主要な茎から生じる派生的な茎。
words.example: I don't think that that branch can support your weight.

words.englishDefinition: A restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
words.japaneseExplanation: セルフサービス形式でキャッシャーで代金を支払う。
words.example: Can you meet me in the cafeteria in ten minutes?

words.englishDefinition: Any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
words.japaneseExplanation: ものを保持するために使用されることができる物の総称（特に一つの輸送手段から別のものに積み込まれることができる標準化された寸法の大きな金属の箱のような物）。
words.example: I can't get this container open...

words.englishDefinition: An accounting entry acknowledging income or capital items
words.japaneseExplanation: 収入または主要な項目を認めている会計項目。
words.example: I don't have a credit card or a bank account.

words.englishDefinition: Normal use of the faculty of vision
words.japaneseExplanation: 視覚機能の通常の使用。
words.example: My eyesight isn't as good as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: The latest and most admired style in clothes and cosmetics and behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 服装、美容、行動における、最も新しく最も賞賛を浴びている様式。
words.example: I never want to hear you talking in this fashion again.

words.englishDefinition: A prominent attribute or aspect of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの顕著な面。
words.example: Please add this feature request.

words.englishDefinition: The concentration of attention or energy on something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何に対する注意あるいはエネルギーの集中。
words.example: We can be busy with so many things that we lose our focus.

words.englishDefinition: The basis on which something is grounded
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを築く基礎となるもの。
words.example: My daughter is the foundation of my world.

words.englishDefinition: The dressed hairy coat of a mammal
words.japaneseExplanation: 哺乳動物の整えられた毛状の外被。
words.example: I want to buy a fur coat for my wife.

words.englishDefinition: An open or empty space in or between things
words.japaneseExplanation: 物の内部または間の空間あるいは隙間。
words.example: I sense a gap between me and my family.

words.englishDefinition: A visitor to whom hospitality is extended
words.japaneseExplanation: もてなしを受ける訪問者。
words.example: Can you tell me where I can find a guest house?

words.englishDefinition: Take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
words.japaneseExplanation: 強制的にまたは所有者の許可なく何かを持ち去る。
words.example: We intend to rob a bank.

words.englishDefinition: Urge to an unnatural speed
words.japaneseExplanation: 異常な速さを求める。
words.example: I don't mean to rush you, but could you please hurry up?

words.englishDefinition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
words.japaneseExplanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
words.example: Do you know how to sail a boat?

words.englishDefinition: Scrape or rub as if to relieve itching
words.japaneseExplanation: かゆみを軽減するかのように掻くあるいはこする。
words.example: I asked him if he would scratch my back.

words.englishDefinition: Make strong or stronger
words.japaneseExplanation: 強くまたはより強くする。
words.example: We must strengthen the ties between our countries.

words.englishDefinition: Make a strategic, offensive, assault against an enemy, opponent, or a target
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵、相手、または目標に対して戦略的な、そして、不快な襲撃をする。
words.example: We have the right to strike.

words.englishDefinition: Imagine to be the case or true or probable
words.japaneseExplanation: 本当であるか、真実であるか、可能性があるか、想像する。
words.example: I suspect Tom didn't do what you said he did.

words.englishDefinition: Be subject to change in accordance with a variable
words.japaneseExplanation: 変数に従って変更される傾向がある。
words.example: You should try to vary your diet.

words.englishDefinition: Change the inherent purpose or function of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの固有の目的または機能を変更する。
words.example: We can only abuse of things that are good.

words.englishDefinition: Put in effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 実施する。
words.example: You never know what you can accomplish until you try.

words.englishDefinition: Gain knowledge or skills
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識または能力を獲得する。
words.example: I managed to acquire two tickets for the concert.

words.englishDefinition: Adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい異なった状況に順応するまたは対応させる。
words.example: We could adapt that to so many different things.

words.englishDefinition: Feel admiration for
words.japaneseExplanation: 賞賛を感じる。
words.example: I looked out the window to admire the view.

words.japanese: 大好きである、敬愛する
words.englishDefinition: Love intensely
words.japaneseExplanation: 情熱的に愛する。
words.example: I just adore your new hat.

words.japanese: ひどく驚かせる（受身形で、ひどく驚く）
words.englishDefinition: Affect with wonder
words.japaneseExplanation: 驚きをもって影響する。
words.example: How amazing that your mother speaks six languages!

words.englishDefinition: Acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠点、短所または失敗を認める。
words.example: I think he should apologize to the teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Originate or come into being
words.japaneseExplanation: 始まる、または発生する。
words.example: I always try to deal with problems as soon as they arise.

words.japanese: じる逮捕する(for〜)、阻止する
words.englishDefinition: Hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of
words.japaneseExplanation: 制止する、の危険のようなあるいは敵のように。それの拡張または影響を確認する。
words.example: You understand that I could arrest you right now, don't you?

words.japanese: 止する主張する、断言する
words.englishDefinition: To declare or affirm solemnly and formally as true
words.japaneseExplanation: 本当であるように厳かに正式に宣言するか、断言する。
words.example: I know how to assert myself.

words.englishDefinition: to spend time or work with a person or group
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や組織と関わったり、協力したりすること。
words.example: Our club associates with local groups on community projects.

words.englishDefinition: Take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であるあるいは事実であると取る。確認または証明なしで受け入れる。
words.example: I have reason to assume that it's not true.

words.japanese: 絶対〜だと確信する、賭ける
words.englishDefinition: Stake on the outcome of an issue
words.japaneseExplanation: 問題の結果に関する賭ける。
words.example: I wouldn't bet on that horse if I were you.

words.englishDefinition: Lose blood from one's body
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体から出血する。
words.example: I bleed when I make love.

words.englishDefinition: Exhale hard
words.japaneseExplanation: 強く息を吐き出す。
words.example: I am waiting for the storm to blow over.

words.englishDefinition: Draw air into, and expel out of, the lungs
words.japaneseExplanation: 肺に空気を吸い込みはき出す。
words.example: I like to breathe the clean mountain air.

words.englishDefinition: Weight down with a load
words.japaneseExplanation: 荷で沈下する。
words.example: I don't want to burden you with my problems.

words.englishDefinition: The financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の期間に生じる（労働による、または労働によらない）財務利益。
words.example: Our income is small, but we get by.

words.englishDefinition: An occurrence of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの発生。
words.example: Let's learn something, like a language for instance!

words.englishDefinition: an organization for research, education, or a special purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 研究や教育などの目的で設けられた機関。
words.example: She works at an institute that studies the environment.

words.englishDefinition: a situation where movement is blocked
words.japaneseExplanation: 車が混み合ったり、機械の物が詰まったりして動けない状態。
words.example: We were late because of a traffic jam.

words.englishDefinition: A state of poor nutrition; can result from insufficient or excessive or unbalanced diet or from inability to absorb foods
words.japaneseExplanation: 栄養不足の状態。食餌の不足や過剰、アンバランスな食餌、食物吸収不能によって生じる。
words.example: Many of our children are suffering from malnutrition.

words.englishDefinition: (chemistry) a substance consisting of two or more substances mixed together (not in fixed proportions and not with chemical bonding)
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つ以上の物質が混ざってできた物質（混合の比率は一定せず、また化学結合を持たない）。
words.example: You can't make a mixture of oil and water.

words.englishDefinition: An organization of military vessels belonging to a country and available for sea warfare
words.japaneseExplanation: 国に属し、海戦のためにある軍艦の編成。
words.example: My father was in the navy.

words.englishDefinition: A nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume; the most abundant element in the earth's crust
words.japaneseExplanation: 2価の非金属元素で、通例無色、無臭、無味の不燃性の二原子気体。体積で大気の28％を占める。
words.example: You can't live without oxygen.

words.englishDefinition: An amount of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間の量。
words.example: I looked after him for a period of time.

words.englishDefinition: An anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図している、または計画した行動を導く、予期された結果。
words.example: You need to find a purpose to your life.

words.englishDefinition: A distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people
words.japaneseExplanation: 地域的、政治的な区域や共同体、人々の集合の明確な区分。
words.example: I asked for a seat in the no-smoking section.

words.englishDefinition: A general conscious awareness
words.japaneseExplanation: 意識されていること全般。
words.example: I get the sense that we speak the same language.

words.englishDefinition: The spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance
words.japaneseExplanation: 実質を除外したある物の空間的配置。
words.example: I don't like the shape of this hat.

words.englishDefinition: An essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物の本質的で特徴的な属性。
words.example: We know by the flowers the quality of the fruit.

words.englishDefinition: All of your experiences that determine how things appear to you
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分にとって物事がどう見えるかを決定する自分のすべての経験。
words.example: We should get used to the reality.

words.englishDefinition: Man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon
words.japaneseExplanation: 人工の装置で、地球あるいは月の周りの軌道を周回する。
words.example: Vladimir used a satellite phone to call for help.

words.englishDefinition: The general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的な状態。与えられた時における様々な状況の複合したもの。
words.example: We talked about how we should deal with the situation.

words.englishDefinition: The part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
words.japaneseExplanation: 腐植土や分解した岩石から成る地表の一部。
words.example: It's difficult to grow anything in this soil.

words.englishDefinition: The manner of construction of something and the arrangement of its parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの建設方法とその部分の調整。
words.example: The structure of the human body can be thought of in the same way.

words.englishDefinition: A submersible warship usually armed with torpedoes
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常水雷で武装している、潜水可能な戦艦。
words.example: What colour is your submarine?

words.englishDefinition: A reference point to shoot at
words.japaneseExplanation: 狙い撃つ標点。
words.example: You hit the center of the target.

words.englishDefinition: Charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の財源のために市民自体・財産・活動に対して課されて徴収される金銭。
words.example: We must pay the tax.

words.englishDefinition: The business of providing services to tourists
words.japaneseExplanation: 観光客へサービスを提供するビジネス。
words.example: The tourism has provided much-needed economic help to this area.

words.englishDefinition: All living things (except people) that are undomesticated
words.japaneseExplanation: 飼いならされていない（人間以外の）すべての生物。
words.example: The animal later died at a wildlife hospital.

words.englishDefinition: Living quarters provided for public convenience
words.japaneseExplanation: 公共の便宜を図って提供されている宿泊場所。
words.example: We need accommodation for six.

words.englishDefinition: A public promotion of some product or service
words.japaneseExplanation: ある製品あるいはサービスの一般宣伝。
words.example: We should have paid attention to the advertisement.

words.englishDefinition: Place in a grave or tomb
words.japaneseExplanation: 墓または墓の場所。
words.example: I would bury it in the garden.
