words.englishDefinition: Have an end, in a temporal, spatial, or quantitative sense; either spatial or metaphorical
words.japaneseExplanation: 一時的か、空間か、量的感覚に、終わりがある。空間的か比喩的。
words.example: You will soon cease to think of her.

words.englishDefinition: Behave as expected during of holidays or rites
words.japaneseExplanation: 休日または儀式で予想通りに振舞う。
words.example: I want to celebrate Christmas with you.

words.japanese: 命令する、支配する、見渡せる
words.englishDefinition: Make someone do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かに何かをさせる。
words.example: Do you know how to use these command line tools?

words.japanese: せる 連絡を取る(with〜)、伝える(to〜)
words.englishDefinition: Transmit information
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を伝達する。
words.example: I want to be able to communicate in French.

words.englishDefinition: to reach agreement by each side accepting some changes
words.japaneseExplanation: 双方が少しずつ譲り合って合意すること。compromise on で妥協する点を示す。
words.example: We agreed to compromise on the meeting time.

words.japanese: 矛盾する、 (予定などが)かち合う
words.englishDefinition: Go against, as of rules and laws
words.japaneseExplanation: 規則や法律などに逆らう。
words.example: How do you two handle conflict?

words.japanese: 祝辞を述べる（on 〜について）、称賛する
words.englishDefinition: Express congratulations
words.japaneseExplanation: 祝意を表す。
words.example: I called up my friend to congratulate him on his success.

words.englishDefinition: Make right or correct
words.japaneseExplanation: 修正する。
words.example: Please correct me when I make a mistake.

words.englishDefinition: Make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 飾り、色などを追加することによってより魅力的にする。
words.example: Can you help us to decorate the party room?

words.englishDefinition: Win a victory over
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝利を収める。
words.example: I know I can defeat you.

words.englishDefinition: Determine the essential quality of
words.japaneseExplanation: の重要な特質を測定する。
words.example: How would define this word?

words.englishDefinition: Give pleasure to or be pleasing to
words.japaneseExplanation: 楽しみを与える、あるいは喜ばせている。
words.example: I want to delight my eyes with the blue sea.

words.englishDefinition: The real physical matter of which a person or thing consists
words.japaneseExplanation: 人やもので構成される、実在する物理的な物質。
words.example: I have no intention of taking this substance tonight.

words.englishDefinition: An illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers
words.japaneseExplanation: 幻影的な妙技。だまされやすい観察者は、魔法であると考える。
words.example: I know that you are up to some trick.

words.englishDefinition: A personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
words.japaneseExplanation: 証拠または確証の基づかない個人的信条または判断。
words.example: I built a house with a view of the mountain.

words.englishDefinition: A simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines)
words.japaneseExplanation: 円形の枠と輻（あるいは堅い円盤）からできていて軸や心棒の回りを回転する（車や他の機械にあるような）単純な機械。
words.example: You are not to speak to the man at the wheel.

words.englishDefinition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
words.example: What was the author thinking while he was writing this book?

words.englishDefinition: Money in the form of bills or coins
words.japaneseExplanation: 紙幣や硬貨の形態をした貨幣。
words.example: I need to get money out from the cash machine.

words.englishDefinition: A person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
words.japaneseExplanation: 弁護士の助言を求める人。
words.example: I have a client waiting in the waiting room.

words.englishDefinition: A covering designed to be worn on a person's body
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の体に着られるようにデザインされた覆い。
words.example: I made this clothing myself.

words.englishDefinition: The preservation and careful management of the environment and of natural resources
words.japaneseExplanation: 環境や天然資源の保護や注意深い管理。
words.example: The island is a conservation area closed to the public.

words.englishDefinition: Everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something
words.japaneseExplanation: コレクションに含まれ、そして保持されるかまたは含まれるすべて。
words.example: What is the content of this book?

words.englishDefinition: A person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art
words.japaneseExplanation: 美術作品の分析と解釈に携わる専門家。
words.example: I realize that I'm my own worst critic.

words.englishDefinition: A period of 10 years
words.japaneseExplanation: 10年間。
words.example: How many years are there in a decade?

words.englishDefinition: An award conferred by a college or university signifying that the recipient has satisfactorily completed a course of study
words.japaneseExplanation: 受賞者が十分に教科課程を完了したことを表明する、単科大学または総合大学が授与する賞。
words.example: She stopped studying and left the university without a degree.

words.englishDefinition: A silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite
words.japaneseExplanation: 延性のある銀白色の金属元素で、主にボーキサイトに見られる。
words.example: My bicycle has an aluminum frame.

words.englishDefinition: A name given to a product or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに付けられた名前。
words.example: I have always wanted to buy this brand of bag.

words.englishDefinition: A native or naturalized member of a state or other political community
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国、または、別の政治共同体に属する生来の、または、帰化した構成員。
words.example: You want to become a citizen, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: A business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国でその会社定款が承認されている企業。
words.example: Damiano became the new face of the corporation.

words.englishDefinition: A quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐怖心を見せることなく、苦痛や危険に立ち向かうことのできる精神のある性質。
words.example: I wish I had the courage to show my feelings.

words.englishDefinition: The place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)
words.japaneseExplanation: 終わり（レースまたは旅行現在）に指定される場所。
words.example: I will call you when I arrive at my destination.

words.englishDefinition: A line leading to a place or point
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所や点へ向かう線。
words.example: I looked in the direction of the window, but didn't see anything.

words.englishDefinition: The branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
words.japaneseExplanation: 電子の発生と影響、電子機器の使用に関する物理学の分野。
words.example: I used to work in an electronics store.

words.englishDefinition: An instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization
words.japaneseExplanation: 規則や一般的なことに当てはまらない例。
words.example: I didn't think that we could make an exception.

words.englishDefinition: A building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のサービスを提供する、または特定の産業に使用される建物あるいは場所。
words.example: First, the waste is brought to the facility.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that contributes causally to a result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果に偶然結びつくもの。
words.example: I don't think that that's a factor.

words.englishDefinition: An established custom
words.japaneseExplanation: 確立した慣習。
words.example: I am in the habit of taking a walk every day.

words.englishDefinition: A component of a mixture or compound
words.japaneseExplanation: 混合物か化合物のコンポーネント。
words.example: I wonder what the secret ingredient is.

words.englishDefinition: Declare untrue; contradict
words.japaneseExplanation: 虚偽であると宣言する。否定する。
words.example: You can't deny the fact that she had a hand in it.

words.japanese: 破壊する、台無しにする
words.englishDefinition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
words.japaneseExplanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
words.example: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

words.japanese: 意見が食い違う、一致しない
words.englishDefinition: Be of different opinions
words.japaneseExplanation: 異なる意見である。
words.example: I guess we could just agree to disagree.

words.englishDefinition: Terminate, end, or take out
words.japaneseExplanation: 終わらせるか、途切れさせるか、取り除く。
words.example: You can't go back into the past to eliminate yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious
words.japaneseExplanation: 決まり悪くさせる。自意識が強いと感じさせる。
words.example: I feel embarrassed when I speak in front of people.

words.englishDefinition: Register formally as a participant or member
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係者かメンバーとして正式に登録する。
words.example: I wish to enroll and I need help.

words.japanese: 疲れさせる、使い果たす
words.englishDefinition: Deplete
words.japaneseExplanation: 使い尽くす。
words.example: We were completely exhausted from the five-hour trip.

words.englishDefinition: Show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
words.japaneseExplanation: 属性、特性、知識、または技能を示す。
words.example: What is your favorite exhibit at the museum?

words.englishDefinition: Sell or transfer abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 海外に売る、または移動させる。
words.example: What would you like to export?

words.englishDefinition: Expose or make accessible to some action or influence
words.japaneseExplanation: いくつかの行動または影響に対して露出するまたはアクセス可能にする。
words.example: I felt I had to expose the whole truth, I just couldn't keep it hidden inside me.

words.englishDefinition: Lose freshness, vigor, or vitality
words.japaneseExplanation: 新鮮さ、活力または体力を失う。
words.example: I don't want to colors of my towels to fade.

words.japanese: 魅了する、うっとりさせる
words.englishDefinition: Cause to be interested or curious
words.japaneseExplanation: 興味か好奇心を持たせる。
words.example: I was fascinated from the moment I saw it.

words.englishDefinition: To enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
words.japaneseExplanation: 限界または真実を越えて拡大する。
words.example: I don't want to exaggerate.

words.englishDefinition: A state of extreme (usually irremediable) ruin and misfortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 極度の（通常取り返しのつかない）崩壊と不運な状態。
words.example: What a disaster, my son has gone and never came back!

words.englishDefinition: The social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたをその力によって要求された行動方針に結びつける社会的勢力。
words.example: You must do your duty, whether you like it or not.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
words.japaneseExplanation: 健康を維持するための様々な方法での筋肉の鍛錬。
words.example: I think you should stop watching TV and get some exercise.

words.englishDefinition: A building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: ガラス壁と屋根のついた建物。管理条件下での植物の栽培と展示のために。
words.example: You can build a greenhouse.

words.englishDefinition: The town (or city) where you grew up or where you have your principal residence
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が育った、あるいは主に生活していた町（あるいは市）。
words.example: What are some things you like about your hometown?

words.englishDefinition: A visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面に作成された視覚表現（物、場面、人または抽象概念の）。
words.example: Could you explain to me what this image means?

words.englishDefinition: Small air-breathing arthropod
words.japaneseExplanation: 小型の空気呼吸を行う節足動物。
words.example: What do you call this insect in English?

words.englishDefinition: The state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠けているか入手できないものを必要とする状態。
words.example: Our problem is more than just a lack of money.

words.englishDefinition: A transparent optical device used to converge or diverge transmitted light and to form images
words.japaneseExplanation: 透明な光学装置で、伝導された光を集中または分岐させ像を作るのに用いられる。
words.example: I see the world through a lens of possibility.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure
words.japaneseExplanation: 室温と室圧で液体である物質。
words.example: I prefer soap as a liquid rather than a bar.

words.englishDefinition: The temporary provision of money (usually at interest)
words.japaneseExplanation: 一時的な金銭の支給（一般に金利付きで）。
words.example: I took out a loan in order to buy a car.

words.englishDefinition: The property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part
words.japaneseExplanation: 2より大きい部分によって生じる、あるいは、に関連した特性。主要部。
words.example: What do you spend a majority of your time doing?

words.englishDefinition: A message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
words.japaneseExplanation: いくつかの製品、理念、アイデア、人、設定に出されるメッセージ。
words.example: I don’t regret it. To tell you the truth, this has given me some publicity.

words.englishDefinition: A device that requires skill for proper use
words.japaneseExplanation: 適切に使用するには熟練を要する装置。
words.example: I don't know how to play an instrument.

words.japanese: ノートコンピューター
words.englishDefinition: A portable computer small enough to use in your lap
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたのひざの上で使用するのに十分小型であるポータブル・コンピュータ。
words.example: I want to buy a laptop computer.

words.englishDefinition: the distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees
words.japaneseExplanation: 赤道から南北にどれだけ離れているかを角度で表す緯度。longitude は経度。
words.example: Can you find the latitude of Tokyo on this map?

words.japanese: 免許証、 (公的機関の)許可
words.englishDefinition: A legal document giving official permission to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをする公式の許可を与える法律文書。
words.example: Do you have a license to do that?

words.englishDefinition: A point or extent in space
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間内での点あるいは範囲。
words.example: What is the location of the country?

words.englishDefinition: How something is done or how it happens
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがされる方法またはそれが起こる方法。
words.example: I find her manner a little hard to take.

words.englishDefinition: A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較の基準。他のものとの評価をするための参考。
words.example: What did you measure it with?

words.englishDefinition: A surrounding or nearby region
words.japaneseExplanation: 周辺の地域、または、近隣の地域。
words.example: You will find your bicycle somewhere in the neighborhood of the station.

words.englishDefinition: A member of a police force
words.japaneseExplanation: 警察のメンバー。
words.example: Do you still want to be an officer?

words.englishDefinition: A possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
words.japaneseExplanation: 状況の好ましい組み合わせによる可能性。
words.example: I decided to take the opportunity to go and visit him.

words.englishDefinition: The state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
words.japaneseExplanation: お金が殆どないか全くなく,物質的な所有物が僅かしかないか全くない状態。
words.example: If you don't respect your money, at least respect our poverty.

words.englishDefinition: The educator who has executive authority for a school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校を管理する権限を持つ教育者。
words.example: I got sent to the principal’s office today.

words.englishDefinition: The act or process of producing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを生み出す行為や過程。
words.example: I have to get a high level of attention from my production team.

words.englishDefinition: Make fit
words.japaneseExplanation: はまる。
words.example: I think that you're going to fit in just fine.

words.englishDefinition: Praise somewhat dishonestly
words.japaneseExplanation: いくぶん不正に称賛する。
words.example: You don't need to flatter me, I already know my worth.

words.englishDefinition: Elaborate, as of theories and hypotheses
words.japaneseExplanation: の理論と仮説のように精巧な。
words.example: We have to formulate a plan if we are to save her!

words.englishDefinition: Pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness
words.japaneseExplanation: 不確実性または不本意なことにためらう、あるいは躊躇する。
words.example: I don't think you should hesitate to speak your mind.

words.englishDefinition: Squeeze (someone) tightly in your arms, usually with fondness
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、愛情表現で腕に（人を）きつく抑える。
words.example: I wanted to hug Tom, but he wouldn't let me.

words.englishDefinition: Reproduce someone's behavior or looks
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の行動や外観を再現する。
words.example: You should imitate his behavior.

words.englishDefinition: Insert casually
words.japaneseExplanation: 偶然挿入する。
words.example: You have to insert the exact amount.

words.englishDefinition: Assert to be true
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であると主張する。
words.example: You will insist on your way all the way, won't you?

words.englishDefinition: Impart skills or knowledge to
words.japaneseExplanation: 技能か知識を分け与える。
words.example: I use animals to instruct people.

words.englishDefinition: Get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
words.japaneseExplanation: 改正するためにまたは妨害するために、あるいは軍事的圧力または脅威を通じて関与する。
words.example: I don't want to interfere with your personal life.

words.englishDefinition: Make sense of; assign a meaning to
words.japaneseExplanation: その意味を理解する。意味を当てる。
words.example: How did you interpret what I said?

words.englishDefinition: Investigate scientifically
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学的に調査する。
words.example: You have to investigate that problem.

words.englishDefinition: Show to be reasonable or provide adequate ground for
words.japaneseExplanation: 十ん分な根拠を提供するまたは論理性を示す。
words.example: I don't have to justify my decision to you.

words.englishDefinition: An area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが行動したり、稼動したり、権力や影響力をもったりする区域：。
words.example: We do have something which is more in your price range.

words.englishDefinition: A result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果。
words.example: We have waited more than a week for your response.

words.englishDefinition: Payment made in return for a service rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 提供されたサービスに対する支払い。
words.example: You told him that he should have a reward.

words.englishDefinition: The property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが予測または必要より少ないときの、その少ない分であることの特質。
words.example: There is never a shortage of things to do here.

words.englishDefinition: A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較の基準。他のものとの評価をするための参考。
words.example: We must either set the standard or lose our cool.

words.englishDefinition: A criminal who takes property belonging to someone else with the intention of keeping it or selling it
words.japaneseExplanation: それを維持する、またはそれを販売するという意図で他の誰かのもの資産を奪う犯罪者。
words.example: What else did the thief take?

words.englishDefinition: An inherited pattern of thought or action
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け継がれた思考、行動のパターン。
words.example: We did what our tradition required.

words.englishDefinition: a particular form or edition of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 製品や作品の特定の型、版。
words.example: Is there a newer version of this app?

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being near to the true value
words.japaneseExplanation: 真の価値へ近い性質。
words.example: I doubt the accuracy of the report.

words.englishDefinition: A vaguely specified concern
words.japaneseExplanation: 漠然としたある関心。
words.example: I am not concerned with this affair.

words.englishDefinition: A representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations
words.japaneseExplanation: 他人や組織の代理として行動する人。
words.example: I just got off the phone with my agent.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（建物など）を作成するために使用される設計図を作る人。
words.example: I was an architect before you were born.

words.englishDefinition: A permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state
words.japaneseExplanation: 陸上の軍隊組織。
words.example: You aren't really going to join the army, are you?

words.englishDefinition: What something is used for
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがそのために使われる。
words.example: I can't function without my morning cup of coffee.

words.englishDefinition: A reserve of money set aside for some purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの目的のために取っておかれる資金。
words.example: I have a college fund.

words.englishDefinition: (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity
words.japaneseExplanation: ポリペプチド鎖を作り出すのに関係するDNA断片。エクソン間のイントロンと同様にコード化DNAに先行していて、続いている領域を含むことが可能である。
words.example: My son has my genes.

words.englishDefinition: All the people living at the same time or of approximately the same age
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ時代に生きている人々やほぼ同年代の人々。
words.example: People of my generation all think the same way about this.

words.englishDefinition: The occurrence of a change for the worse
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪い方へ変化する出来事。
words.example: What is the harm in doing that?

words.englishDefinition: A social unit living together
words.japaneseExplanation: ともに生活する社会的構成単位。
words.example: How many people are there in this household?

words.englishDefinition: The work of cleaning and running a house
words.japaneseExplanation: 家をきれいにし経営する仕事。
words.example: I wish I didn't have to help with the housework.

words.englishDefinition: A forceful consequence; a strong effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 効果的な結果。強力な影響。
words.example: I hope one day you understand the impact of your words.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles
words.japaneseExplanation: 取っ手のない（通例筒状の）広口容器。
words.example: I tried to open the jar, but I couldn't.

words.englishDefinition: A workplace for the conduct of scientific research
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学研究の遂行のための仕事場所。
words.example: My sister works in a laboratory.

words.englishDefinition: The second of two or the second mentioned of two
words.japaneseExplanation: 2者のうち2番目または2番目に名を挙げられたもの。
words.example: I watch more movies than I read books, but I still prefer the latter.

words.englishDefinition: A speech that is open to the public
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般に公開された演説。
words.example: I gave him a lecture he won't forget.

words.englishDefinition: The linear extent in space from one end to the other; the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間の一方の端から他の端までの線的な範囲。ある場所に固定された物の、最も長い水平の寸法。
words.example: I will not go to the length of saying such things.

words.japanese: 発射する、開始する、売り出す
words.englishDefinition: Propel with force
words.japaneseExplanation: 力で推進する。
words.example: Our school will launch a newspaper.

words.englishDefinition: Make lower or quieter
words.japaneseExplanation: より下げる、または、より静かにする。
words.example: Could you please lower the radio a bit?

words.englishDefinition: Be obedient to
words.japaneseExplanation: 従順である。
words.example: We should obey the law no matter what happens.

words.englishDefinition: to fill or use a space or period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所や時間を占めたり使ったりすること。
words.example: The new desks occupy most of the classroom.

words.englishDefinition: Do something to an excessive degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを過度の度合いにする。
words.example: You have to be very careful not to overdo things.

words.japanese: ひっくり返す、打倒する
words.englishDefinition: Cause to overturn from an upright or normal position
words.japaneseExplanation: 直立したか通常の位置からひっくり返えさせる。
words.example: The vase on my desk overturned when I jumped up in surprise.

words.japanese: 借りている、負っている
words.englishDefinition: Be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 抽象的または知的な意味で、負っている。
words.example: I never want to owe money to anyone.

words.englishDefinition: to put things into a bag or box for travel or storage
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行や移動に備えて荷物をかばんなどに詰めること。
words.example: I need to pack my bag for tomorrow's trip.

words.englishDefinition: Arrange in stacks
words.japaneseExplanation: 堆積で配置する。
words.example: How is it that dishes pile up so quickly?

words.englishDefinition: Make (a surface) shine
words.japaneseExplanation: （表面を）輝かせる。
words.example: You should polish your shoes before you go to the party.

words.englishDefinition: Command against
words.japaneseExplanation: 反対する命令を出す。
words.example: You can't prohibit me from doing that.

words.englishDefinition: Impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
words.japaneseExplanation: 処罰を加える。処罰を課す。
words.example: We thought it wrong that you should punish him.

words.japanese: がたがた音がする、ならす
words.englishDefinition: Make short successive sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い連続した音を出す。
words.example: You can't let things rattle you.

words.englishDefinition: Nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
words.japaneseExplanation: 出版物の独立した部分を成すノンフィクションの散文。
words.example: You didn't tell them what you wrote in that article.

words.englishDefinition: A distinct feature or element in a problem
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりとした特徴あるいは問題の要素。
words.example: We must consider every aspect of the problem.

words.englishDefinition: A bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
words.japaneseExplanation: 紐で背や肩に負うカバン。
words.example: What do you have in your backpack?

words.englishDefinition: The lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分的にまたは全体が地下にある構造物の最も低い部分。格納用にしばしば使用される。
words.example: How much money does a basement window like that cost?

words.englishDefinition: The flat part of a tool or weapon that (usually) has a cutting edge
words.japaneseExplanation: （通例）切る刃のついた道具または武器の平たい部分。
words.example: How long is this blade?

words.englishDefinition: A line that indicates a boundary
words.japaneseExplanation: 境界を示す線。
words.example: How long will it be before we cross the border?

words.englishDefinition: a meal where people serve themselves from several dishes
words.japaneseExplanation: 並んだ料理から自分で取り分ける形式の食事。
words.example: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet every morning.

words.englishDefinition: A car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗客を望む場所に連れて行き金を受けとるのを仕事にしている人が運転する車。
words.example: I don't want to walk. Let's take a cab.

words.englishDefinition: A politician who is running for public office
words.japaneseExplanation: 公職に立候補する政治家。
words.example: We promised our support to the candidate.

words.englishDefinition: The overhead upper surface of a covered space
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋の内側の頭上の裏張り。
words.example: How long would it take you to paint the ceiling?

words.englishDefinition: A slight indication
words.japaneseExplanation: わずかな暗示。
words.example: You don't have a clue what you're talking about.

words.englishDefinition: An associate that one works with
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に仕事をする仲間。
words.example: My colleague filled in for me while I was sick.

words.englishDefinition: Freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑いがないこと。自分と自分の能力への信頼。
words.example: You don't seem to have the confidence to do that by yourself.

words.englishDefinition: The means of connection between things linked in series
words.japaneseExplanation: 連続した物事同士の結びつき。
words.example: My friend sent me a link to this video.

words.englishDefinition: Creative writing of recognized artistic value
words.japaneseExplanation: 芸術的価値を認められた創作文書。
words.example: Could you lend me the literature homework?

words.englishDefinition: ways of sharing news and information with the public
words.japaneseExplanation: 新聞、テレビ、インターネットなど情報を伝える媒体。
words.example: Social media helps me keep in touch with friends.

words.englishDefinition: Being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの部分のうち数の少ない方であること、またはそれに関連していること。
words.example: I think you're in the minority there.

words.englishDefinition: A structure erected to commemorate persons or events
words.japaneseExplanation: 人物や出来事を記念するために建てられた構築物。
words.example: Do you want to visit this monument?

words.englishDefinition: A characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情の特徴的な状態（常習的または比較的一時的な）。
words.example: You should learn how to control that mood of yours.

words.englishDefinition: A natural event that involves a change in the position or location of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの位置または場所の変化関連した自然の出来事。
words.example: I didn't vote on the motion.

words.englishDefinition: A motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
words.japaneseExplanation: 2輪と強いフレームを持つ自動車。
words.example: I want to learn how to ride a motorcycle.

words.englishDefinition: The time of a particular event
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な出来事のあるとき。
words.example: Please allow me to say a few words on this occasion.

words.englishDefinition: A personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
words.japaneseExplanation: 証拠または確証の基づかない個人的信条または判断。
words.example: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.

words.englishDefinition: One of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
words.japaneseExplanation: 多くの物のうちで、ただ一つだけが選択される1つ。
words.example: I think that's an option we need to look into.

words.englishDefinition: Sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events
words.japaneseExplanation: 予期していた事態に対し、突然大衆がおそれ、心配すること。
words.example: I was in a panic because I couldn't find my keys.

words.englishDefinition: A piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
words.japaneseExplanation: 装飾、穴を繕ったり塞ぐものとして使用される布の断片。
words.example: My people are working on a patch.

words.japanese: 思い出す、思い出させる
words.englishDefinition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
words.example: Do you recall what happened last year on your birthday?

words.englishDefinition: Get or find back; recover the use of
words.japaneseExplanation: 得るまたは見直す。使用を回復する。
words.example: I hope he will recover quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Use again after processing
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理の後で再度使用する。
words.example: I wish more people would recycle.

words.japanese: 元気にする、新たにする
words.englishDefinition: to make someone feel less tired or renew something
words.japaneseExplanation: 疲れを和らげたり、新しい状態にしたりすること。
words.example: A short walk outside helps refresh my mind.

words.englishDefinition: Feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
words.japaneseExplanation: 悔恨を感じる。遺憾に感じる。
words.example: I have a feeling I'm going to regret this later.

words.englishDefinition: Appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
words.japaneseExplanation: ように見える。類似しているか、類似点をもたらす。
words.example: I think that you resemble your mother.

words.englishDefinition: Reach a decision
words.japaneseExplanation: 決断に到る。
words.example: I hope that you are able to resolve the situation soon.

words.englishDefinition: React verbally
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で反応する。
words.example: I didn't know how to respond to that question.

words.englishDefinition: Place under restrictions; limit access to
words.japaneseExplanation: 制限の下に置く。アクセスを制限する。
words.example: You have no right to restrict Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Appraise critically
words.japaneseExplanation: 批判的に、評価する。
words.example: We need to review the case.

words.englishDefinition: Make revisions in
words.japaneseExplanation: で改訂を行う。
words.example: I am not going out because I have to revise.

words.englishDefinition: Cook with dry heat, usually in an oven
words.japaneseExplanation: 乾式加熱で調理する、通常オーブンで。
words.example: My mom is going to roast a chicken for dinner tonight.

words.englishDefinition: Turn on or around an axis or a center
words.japaneseExplanation: 軸または中心で、あるいは軸または中心の周りで回転する。
words.example: How long does it usually take to rotate tires?

words.englishDefinition: Accepted or habitual practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け入れられることまたは慣習。
words.example: I looked up where this custom comes from.

words.englishDefinition: The act of departing
words.japaneseExplanation: 出発する行為。
words.example: Could you change the departure date for this ticket?

words.englishDefinition: The extent downward or backward or inward
words.japaneseExplanation: 下方、後方、または、内部への範囲。
words.example: I have no doubt about the depth of his feelings.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is desired
words.japaneseExplanation: 望まれているもの。
words.example: I don't have the desire to tell him the truth.

words.englishDefinition: The act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物の摂取（もしくは特定の食物の摂取）を制限する行為。
words.example: I have to lose weight, so I'm on a diet.

words.englishDefinition: Member of a board of directors
words.japaneseExplanation: 理事会の一員。
words.example: I want to see the director of the company.

words.englishDefinition: A system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 生物の群集の物理的環境の相互作用によって形成された体系。
words.example: Snakes are an extremely important part of our ecosystem.

words.englishDefinition: Any strong feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い気持ちの総称。
words.example: Her emotion was too strong for words.

words.englishDefinition: An opposing military force
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵対する軍隊。
words.example: We have to drive the enemy out of our land.

words.englishDefinition: the act of entering a place or joining an organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所に入ることや、組織などに加入すること。
words.example: Entry to the museum is free on Sundays.

words.englishDefinition: Response to an inquiry or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 質問または実験に対する反応。
words.example: I was hoping to get some feedback.

words.englishDefinition: A member of a fire department who tries to extinguish fires
words.japaneseExplanation: 火事を消そうとする消防署の一員。
words.example: I have a son who's used to be a firefighter.

words.englishDefinition: The hard structure (bones and cartilages) that provides a frame for the body of an animal
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物の身体の枠組みを提供する堅い構造物（骨と軟骨）。
words.example: We need a frame for this picture.

words.englishDefinition: A proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体に対する比率（通常、百分率）。
words.example: How much is that as a percentage?

words.englishDefinition: A long (usually round) rod of wood or metal or plastic
words.japaneseExplanation: 木、金属、プラスチックの長い（普通は円みのある）棒。
words.example: I ran into a pole.

words.englishDefinition: A correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 裁判中にまたは罰として監禁される矯正施設。
words.example: I didn't know there was a prison so close to your house.

words.englishDefinition: A mechanical device that moves fluid or gas by pressure or suction
words.japaneseExplanation: 圧力や吸引力で流体やガスを移動させる機械装置。
words.example: Could you show me how to use this pump?

words.englishDefinition: How much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
words.japaneseExplanation: 定量化できるものがいくらあるか、またはいくつあるか。
words.example: What quantity of paper do you need?

words.englishDefinition: A forest with heavy annual rainfall
words.japaneseExplanation: 年間降水量が多い森林。
words.example: We must protect the rainforest.

words.englishDefinition: A storm with rain
words.japaneseExplanation: 雨を伴う嵐。
words.example: We have all been caught outside in a rainstorm.

words.englishDefinition: A practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)
words.japaneseExplanation: （演劇、演説、または、コンサートなどの）公演のための準備としての練習の集り。
words.example: We were busy talking about the rehearsal.

words.englishDefinition: The basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
words.japaneseExplanation: 音楽の基本的なリズムユニット。
words.example: I find peace in the rhythm of life.

words.englishDefinition: The contestant you hope to defeat
words.japaneseExplanation: 打ち負かしたいと願う競争相手。
words.example: We lost against our rival on price.

words.englishDefinition: An established line of travel or access
words.japaneseExplanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
words.example: How long did it take you to do the route?

words.englishDefinition: Something that remunerates
words.japaneseExplanation: 報いるもの。
words.example: I don't deserve the salary they pay me.

words.englishDefinition: A learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
words.japaneseExplanation: 博識な人（特に人文科学で）。長期にわたる研究によって1つ以上の分野の専門知識を得た人。
words.example: A sign is enough for a scholar to understand us.

words.englishDefinition: Personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective)
words.japaneseExplanation: 犠牲となった人（例えば、降伏したり目的の遂行のために亡くなるなど）。
words.example: What is the meaning of fighting without a sacrifice?

words.japanese: 満足させる、 (欲望・条件)を満たす
words.englishDefinition: Make happy or satisfied
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸せにする、または満足させる。
words.example: What else should I do to satisfy her?

words.englishDefinition: Make tight; secure against leakage
words.japaneseExplanation: きつくする。漏出に対して安全な。
words.example: I think that we're ready to seal the deal.

words.englishDefinition: Settle conclusively; come to terms
words.japaneseExplanation: 決定的に解決する。同意に達する。
words.example: We were able to settle the matter finally.

words.englishDefinition: Hit hard
words.japaneseExplanation: 強烈に打つ。
words.example: You make me want to smash your face in.

words.englishDefinition: Examine in order to test suitability
words.japaneseExplanation: 適性を判断するための検査。
words.example: I want to sort this out once and for all.

words.englishDefinition: Separate into parts or portions
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分や部分に分かれる。
words.example: I fear they're going to split up.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being free from danger or injury
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険または危害がない状態。
words.example: I didn't know that you worked for a security company.

words.englishDefinition: One of two divisions of an academic year
words.japaneseExplanation: 学年を2つに分けたうちの1つ。
words.example: I was was driving home for the semester break.

words.englishDefinition: Similar things placed in order or happening one after another
words.japaneseExplanation: 類似した事柄が、順番に置かれる、または、次々と起こること。
words.example: What happens in this series?

words.japanese: ーズ活動のための集まり
words.englishDefinition: A meeting devoted to a particular activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の活動のためにもたれたミーティング。
words.example: Can you meet me after school for a study session?

words.englishDefinition: The merchandise that a shop has on hand
words.japaneseExplanation: 店の手元にある商品。
words.example: We will help you order the stock.

words.englishDefinition: The act of storing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを格納する行為。
words.example: Do you have the keys to the storage room?

words.englishDefinition: A brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
words.japaneseExplanation: 完結な形態で要点を表現する短い言葉。
words.example: Could you please make a summary of the main points?

words.englishDefinition: That part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
words.japaneseExplanation: すべての高度神経中枢を含む中枢神経系のその部分。頭蓋に包まれている。
words.example: I think that part of my brain died a long time ago.

words.englishDefinition: The business given to a commercial establishment by its customers
words.japaneseExplanation: その顧客によって商社とされるビジネス。
words.example: I wish I had gone to a trade school.

words.englishDefinition: A federation (as of American Indians)
words.japaneseExplanation: （アメリカインディアンの連盟のような）連盟。
words.example: We can't marry outside our tribe.

words.englishDefinition: A movable chair mounted on large wheels; for invalids or those who cannot walk; frequently propelled by the occupant
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな車輪に乗った移動可能な椅子。病人または歩くことのできない人のための。
words.example: Can you help get me out my wheelchair?

words.englishDefinition: Special importance or significance
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な重要性や意義。
words.example: I can tell by his accent that he is German.

words.englishDefinition: Move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば食物や雇用を求めて目的地なしに、あるいは目的なしに動きまわる。
words.example: I had some free time, so I decided to wander around town.

words.englishDefinition: Hand over formally
words.japaneseExplanation: 正式に譲り渡す。
words.example: We need to submit the report before the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: Be a substitute
words.japaneseExplanation: 代用品にする。
words.example: I want you all to meet your new substitute teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 権威を不当に使用して咎める、または抑圧する。
words.example: I wonder how I can suppress this feeling.

words.englishDefinition: Relinquish possession or control over
words.japaneseExplanation: 所有物、または管理を放棄する。
words.example: You have three minutes to surrender.

words.englishDefinition: Pass through the esophagus as part of eating or drinking
words.japaneseExplanation: 飲食することの一部として、食道を通過する。
words.example: How is he going to swallow that bread?

words.englishDefinition: Dispose or incline or entice to
words.japaneseExplanation: したいと思わせる、心を向けさせる、あるいは誘惑する。
words.example: I didn't mean to tempt you.

words.englishDefinition: To utter intentions of injury or punishment against:"He threatened me when I tried to call the police"
words.japaneseExplanation: に対して損傷または処罰の意図を発するために：。
words.example: I swear all I meant to do was to threaten Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Remove (a commodity) from (a supply source)
words.japaneseExplanation: （供給源）から（必需品を）移動させる。
words.example: I need to go to the bank to withdraw money.

words.englishDefinition: Arrange or fold as a cover or protection
words.japaneseExplanation: 覆いまたは保護として調整するまたは包む。
words.example: Do you want me to wrap it up as a gift?

words.japanese: 同行する、伴って起こる
words.englishDefinition: Go or travel along with
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に行く、または動く。
words.example: I am not going to accompany the children to school.

words.englishDefinition: Bring an accusation against; level a charge against
words.japaneseExplanation: 告発をする。告訴をする。
words.example: I can't tell what it is I'm being accused of.

words.japanese: 予期する、楽しみに待つ
words.englishDefinition: Regard something as probable or likely
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
words.example: I try to anticipate your every wish.

words.japanese: 承認する、良いと認める
words.englishDefinition: Give sanction to
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可を与える。
words.example: I don't think that your parents would approve.

words.japanese: 非難する、〜のせいにする
words.englishDefinition: Put or pin the blame on
words.japaneseExplanation: 責めを負わせるまたは責任を負わせる。
words.example: I am not to blame any more than you are.

words.englishDefinition: The periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon
words.japaneseExplanation: 月の引力による海面の周期的な上がり下がり。
words.example: We can turn the tide together.

words.englishDefinition: A localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land characterized by a funnel-shaped cloud extending toward the ground
words.japaneseExplanation: 地上へ向かって伸びた漏斗雲が特色で、地上に発生する局地的で激しく破壊的な暴風。
words.example: I was in French class when the tornado hit.

words.englishDefinition: Make a tour of a certain place
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の場所の旅行する。
words.example: We went on a world tour.

words.englishDefinition: Enter upon an activity or enterprise
words.japaneseExplanation: 活動または挑戦に乗り出す。
words.example: I have half a mind to undertake the work.

words.englishDefinition: Push for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを要求する。
words.example: We urge you to be patient.

words.englishDefinition: Get lost, as without warning or explanation
words.japaneseExplanation: 道に迷う、警告あるいは説明なしで。
words.example: We are worried the culture will vanish.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの知覚的な刺激によってぞくぞくさせる。
words.example: Yanni is thrill his daughter is gonna be with him.

words.englishDefinition: Make tight or tighter
words.japaneseExplanation: きついまたはよりきつく作る。
words.example: We need to tighten security.

words.englishDefinition: Copy by following the lines of the original drawing on a transparent sheet placed upon it; make a tracing of
words.japaneseExplanation: 原案の図面の上に置かれた透明シートの線を沿うことにより複写する。トレースを行う。
words.example: How far back can you trace your family tree?

words.englishDefinition: Restate (words) from one language into another language
words.japaneseExplanation: ある言語から他の言語へ（言葉を）言い換える。
words.example: I would like you to translate this book into English.

words.japanese: 閉じ込める、罠でとらえる
words.englishDefinition: Place in a confining or embarrassing position
words.japaneseExplanation: 閉じ込めるまたは恥をかかせる状態に置く。
words.example: I didn't want to trap that animal.

words.englishDefinition: Move or swing back and forth
words.japaneseExplanation: 前後に動くか、揺れる。
words.example: I waved back at him.

words.englishDefinition: Make wider
words.japaneseExplanation: より広くする。
words.example: They're trying to widen the road to the village.

words.englishDefinition: Take the trouble to do something; concern oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: わざわざ何かをする。自らを心配する。
words.example: I don't really want to bother you with my problems.

words.englishDefinition: Confess to God in the presence of a priest, as in the Catholic faith
words.japaneseExplanation: カトリックとしての信心を持って聖職者の面前で神に告白する。
words.example: I must confess I haven't read it yet.

words.englishDefinition: Take possession of by force, as after an invasion
words.japaneseExplanation: 侵略の後などに、力づくで所有物を取る。
words.example: You must conquer your fear of the dark.

words.englishDefinition: Declare to be
words.japaneseExplanation: であると宣言する。
words.example: I want so much to declare my love to her.

words.englishDefinition: An account of the series of events making up a person's life
words.japaneseExplanation: ある人間の人生を編成する一連の出来事の説明。
words.example: This means that you will never see a biography about me.

words.englishDefinition: Eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: 口から胃の内容を放出する。
words.example: I feel so bad I want to vomit...

words.englishDefinition: The power or right to give orders or make decisions
words.japaneseExplanation: 命令をするか、決定をする力または権利。
words.example: I don't have the authority to give you the green light.

words.englishDefinition: A person with whom you are acquainted
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分と知り合いである人。
words.example: I am glad to make your acquaintance.

words.englishDefinition: The practice of cultivating the land or raising stock
words.japaneseExplanation: 土地を耕作する、または家畜を飼育する仕事。
words.example: The land is no longer fit for agriculture.

words.englishDefinition: The making of animated cartoons
words.japaneseExplanation: 動画の製作。
words.example: Computer graphics have changed the world of animation.

words.englishDefinition: (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
words.japaneseExplanation: 心配と神経過敏の比較的永続する状態で、様々な精神障害で起こり、通常、強迫観念に取り付かれた行動またはパニックの発作を伴う。
words.example: I had an anxiety attack.

words.englishDefinition: A meeting arranged in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 前もって準備された面会。
words.example: How long did the appointment with the doctor last?

words.englishDefinition: The mass of air surrounding the Earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球を取り巻く空気の塊。
words.example: I don't like the atmosphere of that school.
